Characterising this sample of lens-galaxies requires accurate measurements of their physical properties. However, standard catalogue photometry often blends the light from the foreground lens and the lensed background source, limiting the reliability of derived galaxy parameters. We present a homogeneous catalogue of photometric redshifts and physical properties for 9538 galaxy-scale strong lenses identified in Euclid's DR1 strong-lens sample. We use deblended multiwavelength photometry obtained from the lens modelling of Euclid and ground-based images with PyAutoLens. The photometric redshifts of the lens galaxies are estimated using the template-fitting code Phosphoros. The stellar masses, SFRs, stellar ages, and metallicities are inferred through SED fitting with Prospector, adopting a flexible non-parametric SFH and a Salpeter IMF. The robustness of the inferred parameters is assessed through comparisons with spectroscopic redshifts and external galaxy surveys. The sample of lenses spans a broad redshift range of $0.13\lesssim z_{\rm phot} \lesssim 1.98$, with a median $z_{\rm phot} = 0.68^{+0.33}_{-0.29}$. The sample is dominated by massive quiescent galaxies with a $M_\ast$ range $[10^{10},\,10^{12.1}]\,M_\odot$ and a median $\log_{10}(M_\ast/M_\odot) = 11.39^{+0.29}_{-0.33}$. This catalogue represents one of the first large-scale characterisations of strong-lens galaxies in the Euclid era. By combining deblended photometry with homogeneous photometric redshift and SED-fitting analyses, it provides a foundation for studies of galaxy evolution, lens-galaxy scaling relations, and the connection between stellar and total mass in strong lenses.

title: A new indirect approach for oxygen abundance determinations across a wide range of physical conditions
background_knowledge: HII 区是年轻大质量恒星电离周围气体所形成的发射线星云，是研究星系当前化学丰度与恒星形成活动的重要探针。氧是除氦以外丰度最高的重元素之一，O/H 常被用作气相金属丰度的代理。星系中 HII 区的金属丰度径向梯度记录了化学增丰、气体吸积与外流、径向混合等过程。准确测定氧丰度需要约束电离气体的物理条件，尤其是电子温度 $T_e$ 与电子密度 $n_e$。在光学波段，直接法通常利用极光线与星云线的比值（如 [O III] $\lambda4363/\lambda5007$）测定 $T_e$，再结合碰撞激发跃迁计算离子丰度。该方法物理基础清晰，但在高金属丰度条件下冷却效率高、$T_e$ 低，极光线非常微弱，观测误差与红化改正会带来显著系统偏差。另一类强线法利用易测的强发射线比值定标丰度，覆盖范围广，但依赖定标样本与电离条件假设，在中高金属丰度区尤其存在系统不确定性。硫的多条发射线（如 [S II]、[S III]）提供了补充诊断；[S III] 极光线与近红外星云线可约束双电离硫的 $T_e$，从而为富金属区提供替代路径。
contribution: 论文提出一种基于硫发射线的 HII 区金属丰度（氧丰度）测定新方法，并以正面朝向的巨型旋涡星系 M101 作为基准检验。作者汇编 151 个 HII 区样本，沿星系径向剖面比较其性质。新方法通过双电离硫的电子温度 $T_e([\mathrm{S\,III}])$ 推算丰度：在可直接测量 [S III] 极光线时使用该线，在超太阳金属丰度区则采用 $SO_{23}$ 参数间接约束。**该方法将 M101 的丰度梯度测量延伸至非常靠近星系中心的位置（0.04 $R_e$）**，并**缓解了基于极光线的直接丰度测定中的系统偏差**，同时为中高金属丰度区改进常用的强线丰度定标提供了新途径。
summary: In this work we present a new approach to derive HII region metal abundances based on sulfur emission lines. We select M101 as benchmark galaxy to test our new methodology along the wide metallicity gradient of this huge face-on star-forming spiral. Based on previous studies, we compile a sample of 151 HII regions and compare their properties base on the galaxy radial profile. The new methodology is based on the derivation of the electron temperature of the double ionised sulfur, either by the direct measurement of the [SIII] auroral line or, at supersolar metalicities, from the $SO_{23}$ parameter. This new indirect method is able to extend the abundance gradient up to the very centre of the M101 galaxy (0.04 $R_e$). This new methodology mitigates systematic biases in direct abundance determinations based on auroral lines, while opening up new opportunities to improve commonly used strong line abundance calibrations in the intermediate to high metallicity regime.

title: Prospects for probing supermassive binary black holes in strongly lensed active galactic nuclei via microlensing effects
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积供能，其辐射来自极小的吸积盘与宽线区等结构。亚秒差距尺度的超大质量双黑洞（SMBBH）是星系并合后黑洞演化的自然产物，但直接空间分辨极为困难。强引力透镜可把高红移 AGN 成像为多个像；透镜星系中的恒星又会对每个像产生微引力透镜效应，使吸积盘不同波长、不同半径区域的辐射被选择性地放大，从而编码吸积盘尺寸、温度分布及源结构信息。若 AGN 实为双黑洞，轨道运动可能引入周期性光变，或使重建的尺寸-波长关系偏离单黑洞模型。因而，强透镜 AGN 的微引力透镜时域与多波段观测，成为搜寻亚秒差距 SMBBH 的潜在途径，但其探测依赖于巡天样本、监测采样频率、基线长度、测光精度和时延测量。
contribution: 本文采用半解析模型评估强透镜 AGN 中亚秒差距 SMBBH 的探测前景，重点关注具有可分辨多重像、适合微引力透镜分析的系统。在考虑星系尺度强引力透镜统计，并把星系团透镜贡献作为乐观统计扩展后，估计 **单个未来巡天最多可空间分辨约 87 个**此类系统，涉及 Vera C. Rubin Observatory（Rubin）、Euclid、中国空间站巡天望远镜（CSST）和 Roman。对于 Rubin WFD 巡天，微引力透镜光变曲线中的周期性振荡可识别 $\sim 0.12-0.68$ 个短周期（$<5$ yr）双黑洞；基于重建尺寸-波长关系的诊断适用于更广泛群体，依模型假设可识别 $\sim 0.4-5.3$ 个系统。CSST、Euclid 和 Roman 最多可分别揭示 $10.6$、$8.9$、$1.2$ 个呈现尺寸-波长特征的系统，以及 $2.3$、$1.9$、$0.3$ 个呈现周期性振荡的系统；这些应视为成像筛选出的候选体，其基于微引力透镜的识别仍需充分的时域后续观测，包括采样频率、监测基线、测光精度和可靠时延测量。结果表明，**强透镜 AGN 为通过微引力透镜寻找候选 SMBBH 提供了有前景但观测要求很高的路径**。
summary: Gravitational microlensing in strongly lensed active galactic nuclei (AGNs) provides a powerful probe of accretion-disk structure and may offer a unique opportunity to identify sub-parsec supermassive binary black holes (SMBBHs) through distinctive signatures. Upcoming wide-field surveys are expected to discover a large sample of strongly lensed AGNs, a fraction of which may host SMBBHs detectable via microlensing. In this paper, we employ semi-analytic models to assess the detection prospects of sub-parsec SMBBHs in lensed AGNs, focusing on systems with resolvable multiple images suitable for microlensing analysis. Accounting for galaxy-scale strong-lensing statistics, and including the cluster-lensing contribution as an optimistic statistical extension, we estimate that up to approximately 87 such systems could be spatially resolved by individual upcoming surveys, including the Vera C. Rubin Observatory (Rubin), Euclid, China's Space Survey Telescope (CSST), and the Roman. For the Rubin WFD survey, we estimate that periodic oscillations in microlensing light curves could identify $\sim0.12-0.68$ short-period ($<5$\,yr) binaries, whereas diagnostics based on the reconstructed size-wavelength relation apply to a broader population, potentially identifying $\sim0.4-5.3$ systems, depending on the model assumptions. CSST, Euclid, and Roman may also reveal up to $10.6$, $8.9$, and $1.2$ systems exhibiting size-wavelength features, and $2.3$, $1.9$, $0.3$ systems showing periodic oscillations, which should be regarded as imaging-selected candidates whose microlensing-based identification requires adequate time-domain follow-up, including cadence, monitoring baseline, photometric precision, and reliable time-delay measurements. Our results show that strongly lensed AGNs provide a promising, though observationally demanding, pathway for finding candidate SMBBHs via microlensing.

title: Cosmic Ray Heating of the Early IGM: Realistic Galaxy Populations, Reduced Efficiency, and 21-cm Signatures
background_knowledge: 宇宙复合后，重子物质主要以中性氢形式存在；第一代恒星和超新星出现后，紫外光子、X 射线与宇宙线注入并逐步加热、电离星系际介质（IGM），开启宇宙黎明与再电离。21-cm 线对应中性氢基态超精细能级跃迁，其信号取决于自旋温度与 CMB 温度之差；Lyα 耦合使自旋温度接近气体温度，而 X 射线和宇宙线加热会改变吸收槽与发射信号。传统图像中，大质量 X 射线双星等 X 射线源是早期 IGM 加热的重要候选；宇宙线也可由超新星遗迹的扩散激波加速，并通过库仑损失等过程把能量传给低能电子和气体。宇宙线加热效率强烈依赖低能质子谱、能量损失、星系形成历史与逃逸，因此需要用更真实的星系族群和谱形在 21-cm 半数值模拟中检验。21cmFAST 可将星系形成、辐射加热与 21-cm 全局信号及功率谱联系起来，并与 EDGES 等实验的全局吸收槽以及未来射电阵列的功率谱测量比较。
contribution: 本文在 21cmFAST 中重新模拟早期 IGM 的宇宙线加热，采用：（i）扩散激波加速预言的动量幂律谱；（ii）自由电子库仑损失；（iii）基于数据约束的原子冷却星系与分子冷却星系族群注入。结果表明，**宇宙线加热比先前估计弱约一个数量级**，原因是动量幂律谱在供应 99% 热量的亚相对论质子（$\lesssim 40\ \mathrm{MeV}$）中注入能量很少。对于位于银河系超新星遗迹推断谱硬端的基准谱斜率及匹配效率，加热降低 $\approx 12$ 倍；再结合更真实的星系模型，在 $z = 15$ 处降低 $\approx 28$ 倍。**在超新星能够提供的效率下，宇宙线加热弱于标准 X 射线加热，且仅凭全局 21-cm 信号无法区分二者**。用 21-cm 功率谱区分宇宙线与 X 射线加热，需要比本地观测预期高数倍的宇宙线效率；在此类效率下，在全局信号匹配时，宇宙线加热在尺度中位数上可比 X 射线加热多产生 $\approx 55\%$ 的功率，而在本地观测所暗示的效率下仅多 3–6%。**类似 EDGES 所声称的平坦吸收槽需要比本地效率高两个数量级以上的效率，超出合理的 Population III 超新星能量预算**。
summary: Cosmic rays (CRs) accelerated by the first supernovae could heat the intergalactic medium (IGM) before reionization. Previous 21-cm simulations, assuming a kinetic-energy power-law spectrum and simplified galaxy populations, found that CR heating can rival X-ray heating from high-mass X-ray binaries, imprint a distinct signature on the 21-cm power spectrum, and flatten the absorption trough of the global 21-cm signal. Here we model CR heating in 21cmFAST with: (i) the momentum power-law spectrum predicted by diffusive shock acceleration; (ii) Coulomb losses off free electrons; and (iii) injection from data-informed populations of atomic-cooling and molecularly cooled galaxies. We find that CR heating is about an order of magnitude weaker than previously estimated because a momentum power law places little energy in the sub-relativistic protons ($\lesssim 40$ MeV) that supply 99% of the heat. For our fiducial spectral slope, at the hard end of those inferred for Galactic supernova remnants, and for matched efficiency, this reduces the heating by a factor of $\approx 12$, and together with a more realistic galaxy model, by a factor of $\approx 28$ at $z = 15$. At the efficiencies that supernovae can supply, CR heating is weaker than standard X-ray heating, and the global signal alone cannot tell the two apart. Distinguishing CR from X-ray heating with the 21-cm power spectrum requires CR efficiencies a few times higher than those expected from local observations. At such efficiencies, CR heating yields up to $\approx 55\%$ more power than X-ray heating at matched global signal (median over scales), compared with only 3-6% at a locally motivated efficiency. A flattened absorption trough, like the one claimed by EDGES, requires efficiencies over two orders of magnitude above the local ones, beyond plausible Population III supernova budgets.

title: Dynamical evolution of the stellar mass function in multiple-population globular clusters
background_knowledge: 球状星团是宇宙中常见的高龄、引力束缚恒星系统，恒星密度高，内部动力学在数十亿年尺度上不可忽略。恒星质量函数（MF）描述单位质量区间内的恒星数目，而初始质量函数（IMF）描述星团形成时的质量分布。星团长期演化受两体弛豫、质量分层、恒星演化、双星作用与潮汐剥离等过程影响：重星倾向于向中心下沉，轻星则向外膨胀并更易被潮汐剥离，因此质量函数会随半径和时间变化。多星族现象是球状星团研究的重要前沿：观测上常通过化学丰度模式与测光分裂识别第一星族（P1）和第二星族（P2），且 P2 往往在空间上更向中心集中。初始空间分布与星族间质量函数差异会与动力学过程耦合，在星团内部留下径向依赖的印记。蒙特卡洛方法可在长时间尺度上高效模拟大量恒星的集体动力学演化，是研究星团质量函数演化的常用工具。bottom-light IMF 指低质量端恒星相对贫乏的初始质量函数，常用于讨论大质量球状星团的观测特征。
contribution: 本文使用 MOCCA 程序开展一组蒙特卡洛模拟，研究包含两个星族的球状星团中恒星质量函数的长期动力学演化，综合考虑两体弛豫、质量分层与潮汐剥离等过程。作者得到 P1、P2 以及整个星团的质量函数斜率随簇心距离变化的径向轮廓，并分别在三维与二维投影坐标下分析这些轮廓。结果表明，这些径向轮廓可由折断幂律很好地描述，**拐点位于半质量半径稍内侧，且该特征部分源于多星族的多尺度结构**。论文进一步考察了若干特征簇心距离，包括局域质量函数斜率等于当前整体质量函数斜率的位置，以及等于 IMF 斜率的位置，并讨论这些位置随星团动力学年龄的演化。研究发现，**初始更向中心集中的 P2 会在外层产生更陡的径向梯度和更陡的质量函数斜率，进而影响星团的整体取值**。受近期观测研究启发——大质量球状星团可能更适合用 bottom-light IMF 描述，且 47 Tucanae 外层 P2 的质量函数斜率较平——作者还探索了一个三参数 bottom-light IMF，并开展了一项 P1 与 P2 具有不同 IMF 的模拟，其中 P2 的 IMF 在低质量端比 P1 更平。
summary: The dynamical evolution of globular clusters is significantly influenced by the multiscale structure introduced by the presence of multiple stellar populations. In this study, we investigate the long-term dynamical evolution of the stellar mass function (MF) within globular clusters hosting two stellar populations using a suite of Monte Carlo simulations run with the MOCCA code. Dynamical processes including two-body relaxation, mass segregation, and tidal stripping result in distinct radial profiles describing the variation with distance from the cluster's center of the stellar MF slope within the first population (P1), the second population (P2), and the cluster as a whole. We show that these radial profiles are well described by a broken power law with a knee located slightly interior to the half-mass radius, a feature partially driven by the multiscale structure of the multiple populations. In both 3D and 2D projected coordinates, we explore several characteristic clustercentric distances within the profile, including those where the local MF slope matches the global value of the present-day MF slope and the initial mass function (IMF) slope, and we examine how these positions evolve with the cluster's dynamical age. Our results highlight how the initially more centrally concentrated P2 drives a steeper radial gradient and a steeper MF slope in the outer regions, which subsequently affects the global cluster values. Motivated by recent observational studies suggesting that a bottom-light IMF may better describe massive globular clusters, as well as measurements of a flatter P2 MF slope in the outer regions of 47 Tucanae, we additionally explore a three-parameter bottom-light IMF and a simulation in which the P1 IMF differs from the P2 IMF, with the P2 IMF flatter than that of the P1 in the lower mass range.

title: Xenon energy-deposition widths in silicon: measurements and Geant4 comparisons
background_knowledge:
多层硅探测器通过带电粒子在硅中电离产生电子-空穴对，读出信号幅度来测量能量沉积；对总能量相同或相近的同位素，各层中的 $dE/dx$ 与 $Z/A$ 及电荷态有关，联合多层能损信息可实现同位素鉴别。其分离能力不仅取决于相邻同位素峰的中心间距，也强烈依赖每个中心峰的宽度。
\n能损涨落来自电离碰撞统计、能量 straggling、电荷态分布及其演化、电荷交换、多次散射与路径长度差异、核反应、探测器电子学分辨以及分析选择窗等因素。重离子在硅中的电荷态输运若建模不足，会改变对能损分布宽度的预测。研究范式通常是用单能重离子束照射不同厚度硅层，测量中心峰宽度，并与 Geant4 等输运程序的电磁物理模型及显式电荷态输运计算比较，以检验模型并评估探测器的同位素分离性能。
contribution: 论文测量了 $^{124}$Xe 在 300 μm 与 675 μm 硅层中的信号中心峰宽度，入射能量约为 152–274 MeV/nucleon，并与 Geant4 11.4.0 电磁物理选项 4（emopt4）以及包含显式电荷交换的计算进行比较。对 300 μm 探测器，emopt4 给出的相对宽度 1.844% 比未选择实验宽度 1.407% 高 31%，比经选择后的宽度 1.060% 高 74%。对 675 μm 探测器，围绕下游信号峰、每个约十个拟合首层标准偏差宽的选择窗给出实验上限估计 0.66–0.74%，而 emopt4 预测为 1.01–1.24%。显式电荷态输运对较薄层给出 0.889–0.932% 的宽度（取决于入射电荷分布），对较厚层给出 0.59–0.63%，这些结果与实验上限估计一致；**emopt4 在所研究的整个能量区间内对两种厚度均高估了能损宽度**。
summary: Energy-deposition fluctuations determine the isotope-separation capability of multilayer silicon detectors. We measure the central peak widths of $^{124}$Xe signals in 300- and 675-micrometre silicon layers at incident energies of approximately 152-274 MeV per nucleon and compare them with Geant4 11.4.0 electromagnetic option 4 (emopt4) and a calculation with explicit charge exchange. In the 300-micrometre detector, the emopt4 relative width of 1.844% exceeds the unselected experimental width of 1.407% by 31% and the selected width of 1.060% by 74%. For the 675-micrometre detector, selection windows around the downstream-signal peak, each approximately ten fitted first-plane standard deviations wide, give experimental upper estimates of 0.66-0.74%, compared with emopt4 predictions of 1.01-1.24%. Explicit charge-state transport gives widths of 0.889-0.932% for the thinner layer, depending on the incident charge distribution, and 0.59-0.63% for the thicker layer. These predictions are consistent with the experimental upper estimates, while emopt4 overestimates the widths for both thicknesses throughout the studied energy interval.

title: Triple-Massive-Exchange Bispectrum of Quasi-Single-Field Inflation
background_knowledge: 暴胀理论认为，早期宇宙经历了一次加速膨胀，其量子涨落被拉伸并冻结为原初曲率扰动，成为宇宙微波背景与大尺度结构的种子。暴胀场的自相互作用及与其他场的耦合会在这些扰动中留下原初非高斯性；其最低阶统计量——双谱，对应三点关联函数的傅里叶变换，是刻画相互作用、粒子谱和真空性质的核心观测量。最小单场慢滚暴胀预言非高斯性很小，而准单场暴胀在暴胀子之外引入一个与暴胀子混合、质量可与 Hubble 尺度相比的有质量标量场。若该粒子寿命足够长，它可在原初关联函数中以交换粒子的方式产生特征信号，尤其在压缩极限下出现随动量比振荡的“宇宙对撞机”信号，从而把宇宙学观测变成探测高能粒子质量、自旋与耦合的“对撞机”。此类交换双谱需要对混合传播子作嵌套时间积分，解析计算通常非常困难；Mellin-Barnes 表示则是一种把积分化为级数、系统提取解析结构的常用数学工具。
contribution: 本文研究标量准单场暴胀模型中的三重交换双谱。该对象自提出以来虽经宇宙对撞机物理快速发展，仍缺乏覆盖全参数空间的解析计算。作者将 Mellin-Barnes 表示直接应用于无质量模式与有质量模式之间的混合传播子，在一般质量和混合强度下把三重交换双谱表示为收敛的双重级数。**由此给出了该双谱在全参数范围内的精确解析结果，解决了其长期难以完整解析求解的问题**；**结果是非微扰的，并具有清晰的物理图像**。该 Mellin-Barnes 方法适用范围广，可推广到其他交换图和关联函数的解析研究。
summary: The triple-exchange bispectrum of the scalar quasi-single-field inflation model has resisted analytic evaluation across its full parameter space since its advent, despite rapid progress in cosmological collider physics. In this Letter, we solve it for general mass and mixing strength as a convergent double series, by applying the Mellin-Barnes representation directly to the mixed propagator between the massless and massive modes. The result is exact, non-perturbative, and physically transparent; the method is broadly applicable.

title: Enhanced Early Structure from Axiodilatons & 21cm Observations
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学以 $\Lambda$CDM 模型为基准：冷暗物质提供引力势阱，宇宙学常数驱动加速膨胀，原初微扰在引力不稳定性下逐级增长，形成星系和星系际介质。暗扇区若包含极轻标量场，可通过与标准模型粒子的微弱耦合改变粒子质量、复合历史、热历史和结构增长；此类模型常由近似整体对称性保护，以保持技术自然性并避免过度偏离观测。21 cm 线来自中性氢基态超精细能级跃迁，其红移后的信号可探测宇宙黎明与再电离时期。微分亮温 $\delta T_b$ 由中性氢密度、自旋温度 $T_S$、辐射背景温度 $T_\gamma$ 和光深决定；$T_S$ 又受 Ly$\alpha$ 光子（Wouthuysen-Field 耦合）、碰撞、X 射线加热和电离过程控制。因此，早期结构形成得越早，恒星和 X 射线源出现越早，21 cm 吸收或发射特征及其演化也会改变。射电干涉阵列如 SKA1-Low 旨在测量该信号，从而检验超出 $\Lambda$CDM 的暗扇区物理。
contribution: 论文关注 axiodilaton 暗扇区模型。该模型利用偶然近似对称性，将观测所需的轻场以技术自然的方式嵌入高能紫外完备理论中，并在未专门调节的情况下缓解 $\Lambda$CDM 现象学中的若干紧张（如哈勃张力与演化暗能量的证据）。作者进一步研究该模型一个意外特征：**其倾向于增强早期结构形成**，这与日益增多的“结构比 $\Lambda$CDM 预期更早出现”的证据相呼应。由于早期结构增长在 21 cm 观测中最易表征，论文采用此前改善其他宇宙学观测的同一组参数，详细预言 axiodilaton 模型产生的 21 cm 信号；在固定天体物理过程时，**SKA1-Low 有望以 $2\sigma$ 置信度将小至几倍 $10^{-2}$ 的 dilaton 耦合与 $\Lambda$CDM 区分开，主要源于结构形成更早**。论文还给出相关宇宙学观测量对质量依赖的完整推导，包括 dilaton 依赖的重子与电子质量如何影响超精细跃迁、Ly$\alpha$ 耦合以及宇宙黎明与再电离时期的 X 射线加热和电离，并详述辐射转移、原子物理以及星系际介质热与电离状态方程。
summary: Axiodilatons provide a promising unified model of the Dark Sector whose properties are motivated by the use of accidental approximate symmetries to embed the light fields needed for observations into well-motivated UV physics in a technically natural way. These models turn out to help ameliorate many current puzzles in $Λ$CDM phenomenology (e.g. the Hubble tension and the evidence for evolving Dark Energy) `for free' despite not being designed for that purpose. We here explore in more detail another serendipitous feature of these models: their tendency to enhance early structure formation, in a way that seems suggestive given the accumulating evidence for structure arising earlier than expected in $Λ$CDM. Since early structure growth is the cleanest to study we explore in detail the expected 21cm signal produced by axiodilaton models, using the same parameter choices that improve agreement with observations elsewhere in cosmology. For fixed astrophysics, we forecast that SKA1-Low could distinguish dilaton couplings as small as a few times $10^{-2}$ from $Λ$CDM at $2σ$, mainly because of the earlier formation of structure. We provide complete derivations of the mass dependence of the relevant cosmological observables, including how dilaton-dependent baryon and electron masses affect the hyperfine transition, the Ly$α$ coupling, X-ray heating and ionization during cosmic dawn and the epoch of reionization. We provide details of radiative transfer, atomic physics and the equations governing the thermal and ionization state of the intergalactic medium.

title: Kinessence, phantom crossing and sign-switching dark energy
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学以广义相对论和 FLRW 度规为基础，将宇宙能量组分分为辐射、物质、暗能量等；大量超新星、CMB 与 BAO 观测表明宇宙当前处于加速膨胀阶段。ΛCDM 模型用宇宙学常数解释加速膨胀，其状态方程为 $w=p/\rho=-1$。若暗能量是动力学标量场，quintessence 通常给出 $w>-1$，phantom 模型给出 $w<-1$，而在单场标准模型中跨越 phantom divide（$w=-1$）较难实现。K-essence 通过非标准动能项改变场动力学，并可借助 K-mouflage 等筛选机制抑制第五力，使标量场与物质的耦合在太阳系检验下仍可行。暗能量与修改引力还会影响背景膨胀、CMB、线性功率谱和结构增长，因此可用 $H(z)$、$f\sigma_8$、$S_8$ 等观测量检验；当前 $H_0$ 与 $S_8$ 等张力也推动超越 ΛCDM 的模型研究。
contribution: 本文提出把 K-mouflage 与 quintessence 结合的 Kinessence 模型：暗标量扇区同时包含 K-essence 动能项与 quintessence 势，并通过 Yukawa 耦合与物质相连，从而在背景演化中实现暗能量状态方程的 phantom crossing 以及暗能量密度的符号改变。作者在 Jordan frame 中研究背景与微扰层次的动力学，重点分析有效状态方程和物质分数，并计算 CMB 谱、线性功率谱以及通过 $f\sigma_8$ 描述的结构增长。**quintessence 势在低红移驱动宇宙加速，且其状态方程大于 -1；Yukawa 耦合的强度可使模型发生 phantom crossing。** K-essence 动能项触发的 K-mouflage 机制屏蔽标量场媒介的第五力，使模型通过太阳系检验，并允许相对较大的物质 Yukawa 耦合 $\beta\sim0.1$，足以在 $z\sim0.5$ 附近跨越 phantom divide。尽管大尺度上存在显著标量相互作用，结构增长相对于 ΛCDM 反而受到抑制；物质分数相对标准模型偏离百分之几，低红移 Hubble 参数高于复合时期，CMB 谱仅显示相对 ΛCDM 的小偏离，而暗能量分数在 $z>2$ 时变为负值。**这些特征有望缓解 $H_0$ 偏大、$S_8$ 所示增长可能偏低以及中微子质量总和上限等张力；CMB 透镜谱相对 ΛCDM 的偏离可能为这类模型提供可探测窗口。**
summary: We introduce Kinessence models where combining K-mouflage and quintessence leads to phantom-crossing of the dark energy equation of state and sign-switching of the dark energy density. This is realised by joining a dark scalar sector comprising K-essence kinetic terms and a quintessence potential together with a Yukawa coupling to matter. We investigate the dynamics of these models in the Jordan frame at the background and perturbative levels. We concentrate on the effective equation of state and the matter fraction for the background. The CMB spectra, the linear power spectrum and the growth of structure via $fσ_8$ are also analysed at the perturbative level. The quintessence potential drives the acceleration of the Universe at low redshift with an equation of state greater than -1. The Yukawa coupling to matter leads to a phantom crossing behaviour depending on its strength. The potential fifth force mediated by the scalar field is screened by the K-mouflage mechanism triggered by the K-essence kinetic terms and passes Solar System tests. This allows for relatively large Yukawa couplings to matter $β\sim 0.1$, large enough to lead to the crossing of the phantom divide at $z\sim 0.5$. Despite a significant scalar interaction on large scales, we find that the growth of structure is reduced compared to LCDM. The matter fraction deviates from the standard model by a few percent and the Hubble rate is larger at low redshift than at recombination whilst the CMB spectra show small deviations from LCDM. The dark energy fraction becomes negative at redshifts greater than 2. All these features should alleviate the various tensions such as the larger value of $H_0$ at small redshift, a possible reduction of growth as measured by $S_8$ and the bound on the sum of the neutrino masses. Deviations from LCDM of the CMB lensing spectrum may provide a detectable window for these models.

title: Measuring Milky Way Mass with RR Lyraes and Blue Horizontal Branch Stars
background_knowledge: 银河系质量是连接星系形成与演化、银河系引力势和暗物质性质的核心量。质量测量通常依赖晕族示踪天体的三维位置与速度：在球对称近似下，可通过球面 Jeans 方程或示踪体质量估计器（TME）反演给定半径内的包围质量；再采用 NFW 等参数化晕模型外推至维里半径，得到 $M_{200}$（相对 200 倍临界密度的维里质量）。天琴座 RR 型变星（RR Lyrae，RRLs）与蓝水平分支星（blue horizontal-branch stars，BHBs）是常用的晕族示踪体：前者是年老、低质量的水平分支脉动变星，后者是年老、贫金属晕星，二者在较大银心距仍可被光谱巡天识别，因而适合描绘银河系外晕的质量分布。该类研究的关键在于样本选择函数、速度各向异性、非球对称性和示踪体数目有限等系统误差，需要借助模拟晕星表进行方法校验。
contribution: 该文利用 LAMOST、SDSS 和 DESI 构建了 7,550 颗 RR Lyrae（RRLs）与 8,230 颗蓝水平分支星（BHBs）的三维运动学样本，覆盖银心距约 10 至 100 kpc，并分别用球面 Jeans 方程和示踪体质量估计器（TME）测量银河系包围质量剖面至约 80 kpc。**两种独立示踪体给出一致结果**：由 RRLs 得 $M(<81.7\,\mathrm{kpc}) = (4.76 \pm 0.23)\times 10^{11}\,M_{\odot}$，由 BHBs 得 $M(<82.8\,\mathrm{kpc}) = (4.66 \pm 0.35)\times 10^{11}\,M_{\odot}$。采用 NFW 剖面外推后，RRLs 与 BHBs 分别给出 $M_{200} = 8.12^{+0.72}_{-0.65}\times 10^{11}\,M_{\odot}$ 和 $M_{200} = 8.13^{+0.78}_{-0.67}\times 10^{11}\,M_{\odot}$。作者还用两个 Auriga 晕的模拟 RRL/BHB 样本检验方法，发现质量分别被低估 $15.5\% \pm 2.8\%$ 与 $11.9\% \pm 3.4\%$；**校正后银河系维里质量约为 $M_{200} = 9.79^{+0.93}_{-0.84}\times 10^{11}\,M_{\odot}$（RRLs）和 $M_{200} = 9.24^{+0.95}_{-0.84}\times 10^{11}\,M_{\odot}$（BHBs）**。
summary: Measuring the mass of the Milky Way is essential for understanding galaxy formation and evolution, characterizing the Galactic potential and assembly history, and probing the nature of dark matter. We derive the enclosed mass profile of the Milky Way out to Galactocentric distances of $\sim80\,\mathrm{kpc}$ using two halo tracers with full 3D kinematics: RR Lyraes (RRLs) and blue horizontal-branch stars (BHBs). Our sample consists of 7,550 RRLs and 8,230 BHBs constructed from the Large Sky Area Multi-Object Fiber Spectroscopic Telescope (LAMOST), the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS), and the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI), spanning Galactocentric distances from $10$ to $100\,\mathrm{kpc}$. We estimate the enclosed mass using two independent methods: the spherical Jeans equation and the tracer mass estimator (TME). The two tracers yield consistent results, with $M(<81.7\,\mathrm{kpc}) = (4.76 \pm 0.23)\times10^{11}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ from RRLs and $M(<82.8\,\mathrm{kpc}) = (4.66 \pm 0.35)\times10^{11}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ from BHBs. Adopting an NFW profile to extrapolate the enclosed mass beyond the outermost radius probed by our tracers, we infer virial masses of $M_{200} = 8.12^{+0.72}_{-0.65}\times10^{11}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ from RRLs and $M_{200} = 8.13^{+0.78}_{-0.67}\times10^{11}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ from BHBs. We further validate our methodology using mock RRL and BHB samples constructed from two Auriga halos, finding that the inferred masses are underestimated by $15.5\%\pm2.8\%$ for RRLs and $11.9\%\pm3.4\%$ for BHBs, respectively. After correcting for these systematic errors, the Milky Way virial masses are $M_{200} = 9.79^{+0.93}_{-0.84}\times10^{11}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ from RRLs and $M_{200} = 9.24^{+0.95}_{-0.84}\times10^{11}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ from BHBs.

title: $r$-Largest Order Statistics for Galaxy Cluster Cosmology I: Reconstruction of the high-mass end of the Halo Mass Function
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中在引力作用下形成的最大的维里化结构之一，其数量与质量分布对宇宙膨胀史、物质密度、涨落幅度以及原初扰动性质高度敏感。星系团宇宙学的核心观测量之一是晕质量函数（Halo Mass Function，HMF），即单位体积、单位质量区间内的暗物质晕或星系团数目随质量和红移的分布。HMF 的高质量端对应极稀有的巨质量体系，其丰度呈指数式压低，因此既是检验引力增长和暗能量模型的敏感探针，也受宇宙学体积有限、样本量小而导致的统计误差限制。传统研究通常利用模拟校准的 HMF 拟合星系团质量—红移分布，并据此推断宇宙学参数；极端值统计（Extreme Value Statistics，EVS）和块最大值方法则从“给定体积内最重天体”的分布中提取高质量端信息。此类方法把稀有峰值的统计性质与 HMF 尾部联系起来，但只使用单一最大值会丢弃体积内次重天体的信息。顺序统计量、联合极值分布以及广义极值（Generalized Extreme Value，GEV）参数因此成为研究高质量端和原初非高斯性的自然工具。
contribution: 论文提出面向星系团的 $r$-最大顺序统计量（$r$-largest order statistics，$r$-LOS）框架，将传统 EVS 从“给定体积内最重星系团”的概率分布推广到前 $r$ 个最重星系团按质量降序排列的联合分布，并系统建立相应的数学形式、讨论其渐近性质以及若干与星系团宇宙学相关的关系。核心结果是：**利用扩展的块最大值方法纳入每个体积内最重的 $r$ 个星系团，可由 GEV 参数推断并重建 HMF 的高质量端**，从而**仅依赖晕族群中的少量子样本即可恢复 HMF 的高质量尾部**。作者使用数值模拟的共动天区和光锥晕星表对上述关系进行了验证，并进一步考察了 $r$-LOS 框架对原初非高斯性的敏感性，重点关注其对大质量星系团统计性质的影响。
summary: We introduce the $r$-largest order statistics ($r$-LOS) framework for galaxy clusters, a generalization of the standard extreme value statistics (EVS) approach. While conventional EVS focuses on the probability distribution of the most massive cluster within a given volume, the $r$-LOS framework exploits the additional statistical information encoded in the joint distribution of the $r$ most massive clusters, ranked in descending order of mass. We develop the corresponding mathematical formalism, discuss its asymptotic properties, and derive a set of relations relevant to galaxy cluster cosmology. In particular, we demonstrate that the high-mass end of the halo mass function (HMF) can be reconstructed from the generalized extreme value (GEV) parameters inferred using an extension of the block maxima method that incorporates the $r$ most massive clusters in each volume. This provides a means of recovering the high-mass tail of the HMF using only a small subsample of the halo population. We validate these relations using both comoving and light-cone halo catalogues from numerical simulations. Finally, we investigate the sensitivity of the $r$-LOS framework to primordial non-Gaussianity, focusing on its impact on the statistics of massive clusters.

title: The Distant Milky Way Halo from the Southern Hemisphere: Spatially broad and closer stellar debris associated to the Magellanic Stream
background_knowledge: 银河系晕及其中的恒星流是检验等级结构形成和星系并合历史的重要窗口。按照 ΛCDM 图像，较大的银河系通过吸积和并合较小的卫星星系逐步生长；被潮汐瓦解的矮星系或球状星团会留下沿轨道分布的恒星碎片，即恒星流。这些无碰撞的恒星示踪物能长期保留母体轨道和化学信息，因此可用于重建银河系势场、卫星星系轨道以及麦哲伦系统的相互作用史。麦哲伦系统由大麦哲伦云（LMC）和小麦哲伦云（SMC）组成，是银河系最重要的近邻卫星系统之一；其气体结构 Magellanic Stream（MS）横跨天区超过 $150^\circ$，通常认为由 LMC 与 SMC 在落入银河系过程中的相互作用以及银河系潮汐作用塑造。若 MS 有恒星对应体，这些恒星应像无碰撞碎片一样记录麦哲伦系统过去的轨道，但恒星 counterpart 非常暗弱、面密度低且与银河系晕星和厚盘星混杂，过去仅证认出少量候选体。观测上通常结合宽视场测光（如 DELVE、VHS）筛选远处 K 型巨星等明亮巨星，利用 Gaia 天体测量给出自行，再用中/高分辨率光谱测量视向速度和金属丰度，并通过分光或测光距离、轨道积分和势场模型判断其是否属于麦哲伦碎片。
contribution: 论文利用 DELVE DR2、VHS DR5 测光与 Gaia DR3 天体测量构建了 87,763 颗远处 K 型巨星候选体目录，并对沿 MS 尾随部分的 51 个目标取得 VLT 与 Magellan 光谱。结合视向速度、分光光度距离和自行，作者**新证认了五颗 MS 恒星候选体，其日心距离约为 $58$–$95\ \mathrm{kpc}$**。这些候选体的金属丰度与 SMC 外围区域相符，且在含时变的银河系–LMC–SMC 势场中的轨道积分支持其可能具有麦哲伦起源。与先前候选体合并后，样本在麦哲伦纬度上的分布**显著宽于现有模型预言的狭窄星流，暗示 MS 的恒星对应体是一个空间上延展的碎片场**。此外，这些候选体总体上**比模拟给出的碎片更靠近银河系**；作者提出较新、偏心率更低的 SMC 轨道可能解释这一距离差异，但强调仍需新的数值模拟检验其对恒星碎片的影响，并需要更大的光谱样本加以确认。
summary: The Magellanic Stream (MS) is a gaseous structure extending over $150^\circ$ across the sky, likely formed through interactions between the Large and Small Magellanic Clouds (LMC and SMC) as they fell into the Milky Way (MW). Its predicted stellar counterpart would provide a collisionless record of these interactions, but few candidate members have been identified. To expand this sample, we constructed a catalog of 87,763 distant K-giant candidates using DELVE DR2 and VHS DR5 photometry and Gaia DR3 astrometry, and analyzed VLT and Magellan spectra of 51 targets along the trailing MS. Combining radial velocities, spectrophotometric distances, and proper motions, we identify five new MS candidates at 58--95 kpc. Their metallicities are consistent with the outskirts of the SMC, while orbit integrations in a time-dependent MW--LMC--SMC potential support a possible Magellanic origin. Combined with previously identified candidates, these stars span a substantially broader range of Magellanic latitude than predicted by existing models, suggesting an extended debris field rather than a narrow stream. The candidates also lie predominantly closer than the simulated debris. More recent, less eccentric SMC orbits may help explain this distance discrepancy, although new simulations are required to test their implications for the stellar debris, along with larger spectroscopic samples.

title: Rapidly Spinning Primordial Black Holes from Confinement
background_knowledge: 原初黑洞（primordial black holes, PBHs）是早期宇宙中由非恒星坍缩过程形成的黑洞，其质量由形成时的视界质量决定，是连接暴胀、早期相变、拓扑缺陷与超越标准模型物理的重要探针。常规图像是：在辐射主导时期，若某个共动尺度上的密度扰动足够大，进入视界后即可在引力坍缩中形成 PBH；其丰度、质量函数和自旋分布取决于扰动谱、形成阈值及非球对称动力学。自旋常用无量纲参数 $a_* = cJ/(GM^2)$ 描述，$a_* = 0$ 为非旋转，$a_* = 1$ 为极端 Kerr 黑洞。多数标准形成机制预期自旋较小，因为坍缩近似球对称；但若形成过程中存在潮汐力矩、各向异性或拓扑缺陷，就可能产生高自旋。规范理论中的禁闭会把色通量挤压成通量管，使重夸克—反夸克对之间具有线性势；其磁对偶图像是希格斯相把磁通禁闭成弦，弦连接磁单极子—反单极子对。早期宇宙中的暴胀扰动、宇宙学潮汐和大尺度结构可改变这些粒子对的相对运动。该子领域的研究范式是把粒子物理相变与缺陷动力学同宇宙学演化耦合，计算 PBH 的形成率、质量与自旋分布，并用引力波、透镜和宇宙学观测检验。
contribution: 论文提出，禁闭机制可以把相距很远的粒子对转变为快速旋转的原初黑洞。重夸克—反夸克对由通量管拉近，储存的势能转化为相对论性动能；在磁对偶图像中，希格斯相把磁通禁闭成连接单极子—反单极子对的弦。粒子接近时，宇宙学潮汐与弦弯曲可偏转其轨道而使其错过，这些扰动既可源于暴胀期，也可在后期产生。因此黑洞形成需要来自光滑、宽遭遇分布的稀有近距离通过。**新生黑洞的自旋分布密度随无量纲自旋 $a_*$ 线性上升直至极端值 $a_* = 1$，平均无量纲自旋为 $2/3$**；数值弦演化重现了这一规律。错过的粒子对可保持束缚，通过辐射损失能量并后续坍缩为更轻的近极端黑洞，从而产生随机引力波背景。**尽管丰度仍依赖模型，禁闭机制留下了可由引力波观测检验的独特自旋印记。**
summary: Confinement can turn widely separated particles into rapidly spinning primordial black holes. A flux tube pulls a heavy quark--antiquark pair together, converting its stored energy into relativistic motion. The same mechanism is possible in the magnetic dual, where a Higgs phase confines magnetic flux into a string joining a monopole--antimonopole pair. As the particles approach, cosmological tides and string bends can deflect their motion and make them miss. These disturbances can originate during inflation or be generated later. Black-hole formation then requires rare close passages from a smooth, broad encounter distribution. The resulting natal spin density therefore rises linearly to extremality, with mean dimensionless spin two thirds. Numerical string evolutions recover this law. Pairs that miss can remain bound, radiate and later collapse into lighter, near-extremal holes, sourcing a stochastic gravitational-wave background. Although the abundance remains model dependent, confinement leaves a unique spin signature that gravitational-wave observations can test.

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1): VIS processing and data products
background_knowledge: Euclid 是欧洲空间局主导的宇宙学空间任务，其可见光成像仪 VIS 通过高分辨率、宽视场成像支持弱引力透镜和星系成团等宇宙学测量。此类巡天的科学产出依赖大规模、均匀且定标精确的成像数据；典型处理流程包括平场与偏压校正、背景估计、宇宙线去除、天体检测、星表匹配、天体测量与光度定标，以及系统误差表征。数据发布通常不仅提供图像，还包含校准帧、权重与掩膜、星表及精度评估，供宇宙学与星系演化研究使用。
contribution: 论文介绍 Euclid Data Release 1（DR1）中 VIS 可见光成像仪的数据产品与处理特征。数据集包含 42,092 帧校准图像；经验证的标称曝光覆盖约 2092 平方度的天空。文中说明自先前版本以来 VIS processing function（PF）所做的小幅修改，并评估宽巡天数据的定标精度。对 $18.5 < I_{\rm E} < 19.8$ 的参考恒星样本，**天体测量内部/外部弥散在象限级别为 0.08/0.18 mas，在源级别为 3.4/5.6 mas；光度内部/外部弥散在象限级别为 0.76/1.4 mmag，在源级别为 11/25 mmag**，显示出优异的测量精度。论文还表征残余系统效应，包括依赖焦平面的变化、随时间变化的光度偏移和依赖颜色的质心偏移；最深 VIS 图像的噪声底似乎由暗弱星系的延展漫射光决定。总体而言，**DR1 VIS 数据满足发射前任务要求**，其 42,092 幅图像提供了首批以 VIS 视角对天空进行的大规模观测。
summary: This paper describes the characteristics of the Euclid visible imager (VIS) data delivered as part of the Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). This data set contains 42092 calibrated frames. Validated nominal exposures cover 2092 deg$^2$ of sky. We outline the minor changes made to the VIS processing function (PF) since previous releases. For the wide survey, the photometric and astrometric accuracy of the reference stellar sample $(18.5 < I_{\rm E} < 19.8)$ is excellent. The internal and external astrometric dispersions are 0.08 and 0.18 mas, respectively, at the quadrant level, and 3.4 and 5.6 mas at the source level. The corresponding internal and external photometric dispersions are 0.76 and 1.4 mmag at the quadrant level, and 11 and 25 mmag at the source level. We characterise remaining astrometric and photometric systematic effects: focal-plane-dependent variations; time-dependent photometric offsets; and colour-dependent centroid shifts. The noise floor in the deepest VIS images appears to be set by the extended diffuse light of faint galaxies. Globally, the DR1 VIS data meet pre-launch mission requirements and the 42092 images it contains provide our first substantial look at the sky as seen by VIS.

title: A statistical study of ionized outflows in low-mass galaxies from DESI DR1
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化的核心问题之一是反馈（feedback）如何调节星系中的气体含量与恒星形成，并驱动星系与周星系介质（CGM）、星系际介质（IGM）之间的重子循环。低质量星系引力势阱浅，超新星和恒星风更容易把气体与金属抛出星系，形成星系风（galactic winds）；这些外流可富集 CGM、抑制后续恒星形成，并影响低质量端的星系数量密度与质量—金属丰度关系。观测上常利用 [OIII]、H$\alpha$ 等强发射线的线翼或速度展宽证认电离气体外流，并用质量加载因子 $\eta=\dot M_{\rm out}/{\rm SFR}$ 描述单位恒星形成率所驱动的外流质量。理论模拟通常预测低质量星系具有较大的 $\eta$，但电离气体只对应外流的一个相，必须与分子、中性及热相等多相观测结合。DESI 的大样本光谱为在统计层面研究低质量星系外流及其与恒星质量、恒星形成率、主序位置和 AGN 活动的关系提供了条件。
contribution: 论文基于 DESI DR1 光谱，在 $z<0.45$、$\log(M_{*}/M_{\odot}) \lesssim 10$ 的低质量星系中利用 [OIII] 与 H$\alpha$ 发射线系统搜寻电离气体外流，证认出约 $5800$ 个具有稳健外流信号的矮星系。样本大多数是位于恒星形成主序之上的恒星形成星系，少数为复合型（composite）和 AGN 宿主。该工作测得质量加载因子范围为 $\eta=0.001$--$1$，中位数 $\eta\sim0.01$，与相近恒星质量下的以往结果一致；这些值比宇宙学模拟预测低 $1$--$2$ dex，**表明电离相可能只追踪总外流质量的一小部分**。外流速度足以在 $\gtrsim80\%$ 的样本中富集 CGM，而高效逃逸到 IGM 主要出现在复合型和 AGN 宿主中。质量加载因子随恒星质量增加而下降，尽管存在归一化偏移，却大致重现了模拟中的趋势。将单源证认与一般低质量恒星形成星系的叠加光谱比较，作者发现叠加样本的 $\eta$ 系统性偏低，但差异在恒星形成主序以上的偏移增大时减小；结合 $\eta$ 与比恒星形成率（sSFR）的正相关，**这说明增强且爆发式的恒星形成会调节反馈效率并塑造星系风**。总体而言，**电离外流在低质量星系的重子循环中扮演重要角色，而全面理解星系演化中的反馈仍需多相外流研究**。
summary: We present a statistical analysis of ionized gas outflows in a large sample of low-mass ($\mathrm{log(M_{*}/M_{\odot})\lesssim10}$) galaxies at $z<0.45$ from the first data release of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI DR1). Using [OIII] and H$α$ emission lines, we identify $\sim5800$ dwarf galaxies with robust signatures of ionized outflows. Most are star-forming systems above the star-forming main sequence, with a smaller fraction of composites and AGN hosts. The derived mass-loading factors span $η=0.001-1$, with a median $η\sim0.01$, consistent with previous studies at similar stellar masses. These values are $1$--$2$ dex lower than predicted by cosmological simulations, suggesting that the ionized phase traces only a minor fraction of the total outflow mass. Outflow velocities are sufficient to enrich the circumgalactic medium in $\gtrsim80\%$ of cases, while escape into the intergalactic medium appears efficient mainly in composite and AGN hosts. We find that mass-loading factors decrease with stellar mass, broadly reproducing simulated trends despite the normalization offset. Comparing individual detections with stacked spectra of the general low-mass star-forming population, we find systematically lower mass-loading factors in the stacks, although the difference decreases toward larger offsets above the star-forming main sequence. Together with a positive correlation between mass-loading factor and specific star-formation rate, this suggests that enhanced star formation and burstiness regulate feedback efficiency and shape galactic winds. Our results highlight the role of ionized outflows in the baryon cycle of low-mass galaxies and the need for multiphase studies to fully understand feedback in galaxy evolution.

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) A: Strong lens catalogue overview
background_knowledge: 强引力透镜是前景大质量星系（或星系团）的引力场使背景星系光线偏折，从而在观测上形成弧、环或多重像的现象。其物理基础是广义相对论：质量分布决定偏折角，像的位置与形态编码了透镜质量分布、暗物质子结构以及背景源的红移和结构。对星系尺度强透镜，典型爱因斯坦半径约为角秒量级，因而需要高分辨率、宽视场且稳定的空间成像来系统发现和建模。传统上强透镜多为少量、异质样本，常用于测量透镜星系质量、约束暗物质性质、研究高红移星系放大后的形态，以及通过时间延迟宇宙学测量哈勃常数。欧几里得（Euclid）空间望远镜的近红外高分辨率宽视场巡天为把强透镜从稀有个例推进到大样本统计工具提供了条件；核心研究范式包括自动化候选发现、机器学习筛选、公民科学与专家目视复核、统一建模及统计性质分析。
contribution: 论文基于欧几里得数据发布 1（Euclid DR1）在 $2000\ \mathrm{deg}^2$ 天区内给出 **15 072 个高置信度强透镜候选体**，其中 6073 个为 A 级（“确定透镜”）、8999 个为 B 级（“可能透镜”），并另公布 9010 个 C 级（“候选透镜”）。该高置信度样本数量 **超过此前所有星表之和**，建立了大而均匀、具备高分辨率成像的星系尺度强透镜数据集，使强透镜从稀有发现转变为天体物理与宇宙学的稳健统计工具。作者在 DR1 约 9 亿个源中筛选出 6800 万个源，使用综合五个机器学习模型得分、约 7000 名公民科学家与 67 名强透镜专家的目视分类的专用发现流程进行搜索。除经典爱因斯坦环外，星表还包含 **84 个双源面透镜候选体**、**1000 多个盘状透镜候选体**（两类此前已知样本很少的稀有系统），以及数百个被透镜化的 AGN 和类星体候选体。论文为 A+B 级系统提供自动透镜模型，并给出偏折星系的测光红移与恒星族性质，形成可直接用于科学分析的数据产品。结果表明偏折星系大多为大质量且宁静的星系，恒星质量 $\log_{10}(M_\ast / M_\odot) = 11.39^{+0.29}_{-0.33}$（Salpeter 初始质量函数；16–84 百分位范围），测光红移 $z = 0.68^{+0.33}_{-0.29}$，比此前地面透镜样本延伸到更高红移，典型爱因斯坦半径为 $0.85^{+0.44}_{-0.24}$ 角秒。按面积外推，Euclid 宽巡天预计将有 **超过 100 000 个高置信度强透镜候选体**。
summary: We present 15 072 high-confidence strong lens candidates in Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1), spanning 2000 deg$^2$. These comprise 6073 grade A ('sure lens') and 8999 grade B ('probable lens') systems, which we publish alongside a further 9010 grade C ('possible lens') candidates. With more high-confidence candidates than all previous catalogues combined, this sample establishes a large, homogeneous data set of galaxy-scale strong lenses with high-resolution imaging, transforming strong lensing from a field of rare discoveries to a robust statistical tool for astrophysics and cosmology. Of the roughly 900 million sources in DR1, we searched the 68 million passing our catalogue selection using a bespoke discovery pipeline that synthesises scores from five machine-learning models with visual classifications from around 7000 citizen scientists and 67 strong lensing experts. Beyond classical Einstein rings, our catalogue includes 84 candidate double-source-plane lenses and over 1000 candidate disc lenses, two exotic classes with few previously known examples, as well as several hundred candidate lensed AGN and quasars. We deliver automated lens models for the combined grade A+B systems, and photometric redshifts and stellar population properties for the deflector galaxies, providing immediate science-ready data products. We find that the majority of the deflector galaxies are massive and quiescent, with stellar masses of $\log_{10}(M_\ast /M_\odot) = 11.39^{+0.29}_{-0.33}$ (Salpeter initial mass function; 16th-84th percentile range). The deflector galaxies span a range of photometric redshifts ($z=0.68 ^{+0.33}_{-0.29}$), extending to higher redshifts than previous ground-based lens samples, and the lenses have a typical Einstein radius of $0.85 ^{+0.44}_{-0.24}$ arcsec. Extrapolating by area, we expect over 100 000 high-confidence strong lens candidates in the Euclid Wide Survey.

title: Identification of extragalactic radio sources in the VISTA survey of the Magellanic Clouds using an unsupervised machine learning algorithm
background_knowledge: 在射电波段，活动星系核（AGN）由其中心超大质量黑洞吸积产生的相对论性喷流发出强烈同步辐射，耀变体则因喷流接近视线方向而具有显著增强、宽波段辐射和强变光。低红移星系、星暴星系等也会通过同步辐射与自由—自由辐射在射电波段被探测到。与此同时，银河系内尘埃恒星天体、年轻恒星天体、行星状星云和高自行恒星可在光学—红外—射电多波段留下不同印记，成为拥挤天区中重要的污染源。麦哲伦云视场中恒星密集，背景河外源与前景恒星混杂，传统靠单一波段或颜色选择区分恒星与河外源、AGN 与普通星系较为困难。多波段测光与颜色可刻画天体光谱能量分布（SED），对红移、尘埃消光、恒星大气和 AGN 喷流等物理性质敏感。t-SNE 是一种非线性降维与可视化方法，可在无标签情况下把高维测光特征映射到二维平面，使 SED 相似的天体聚集；随后可利用已有分类样本解释簇的物理含义。VMC 提供近红外测光，EMU/ASKAP 提供射电信息，SALT 光谱则可用于确认天体类型和测量红移。
contribution: 论文对 VMC 与 EMU/ASKAP 联合探测到的 6,652 个大麦哲伦云源和 1,356 个小麦哲伦云源，使用无监督的 t-SNE 算法进行聚类。其特征包括从光学到射电的多波段测光和颜色，目标是在拥挤视场中把相似天体聚集到二维 t-SNE 图上。作者利用已有分类源把簇划分为五类：AGN、低红移星系、耀变体、尘埃恒星天体（如年轻恒星天体、行星状星云等）以及高自行恒星。文献中已有的测光分类与特定簇相符，同时该方法还为 t-SNE 图上缺乏既有分类的区域提供了线索。**该工作表明，无监督机器学习结合光学到射电测光能够有效区分恒星与河外源，并进一步区分 AGN 与普通星系。** 与之配套的 SALT 新光谱包括 **新发现的最高红移至 $z=3.3$ 的 AGN**，以及麦哲伦云发射线天体。
summary: The Magellanic Clouds benefit from a wealth of data across the electromagnetic spectrum, but extracting extragalactic sources from these crowded fields is a less than straightforward endeavour. We used an unsupervised machine learning algorithm (t-distributed stochastic neighbourhood embedding; t-SNE) to classify 6,652 and 1,356 sources in the Large and Small Magellanic Clouds, respectively, that were detected in the VISTA Survey of the Magellanic Clouds (VMC) and the Evolutionary Map of the Universe (EMU) survey with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP). Multi-wavelength photometry and colours from optical to radio were used as features to cluster similar sources together in 2D space on a t-SNE map. We used previously classified sources to separate the clusters into five classes: AGN, low-redshift galaxies, blazars, dusty stellar objects (e.g. young stellar objects, planetary nebulæ etc) and high proper-motion stars. Previous photometric classifications from the literature match with specific clusters identified, as well as provide insight on areas of the t-SNE map for which there are no previous classifications. This work shows that the combination of unsupervised machine learning with photometry from optical to radio has proven adept at separating the stellar from the extragalactic, and the AGN from the galaxies. Our associated new spectroscopy with SALT includes new discoveries of AGN up to redshift 3.3 and Magellanic emission-line objects.

title: Cubic Curvature Deformations to the Kerr Black Hole Shadow
background_knowledge: 在广义相对论中，黑洞时空由质量、自旋等参数刻画，旋转且无电荷的黑洞由 Kerr 度规描述。强引力场会使光子沿弯曲的零测地线传播；在黑洞附近，光子球与临界曲线决定哪些光线能被捕获，从而在远处观测者看到的图像中形成中心暗区，即黑洞阴影。阴影的轮廓、表观大小和不对称性携带着黑洞质量、自旋、观测者倾角以及时空几何偏离广义相对论的信息。事件视界望远镜（EHT）在 M87* 与 Sgr A* 等源上开展视界尺度干涉观测，使黑洞阴影成为强场引力检验的新窗口。在有效场论框架下，高阶曲率修正可视为对 Kerr 时空的微扰；当测地线方程不可分离时，通常需要数值求解零测地线并进行射线追踪，以构造理论模板并与观测比较。
contribution: 论文在有效场论框架下研究三次曲率修正对旋转黑洞阴影的影响。作者从包含两组独立三次曲率耦合的微扰修正 Kerr 度规出发，不假设测地线方程可分离，通过数值积分零测地线构造黑洞阴影，并采用哈密顿射线追踪方法系统考察阴影几何对高阶曲率耦合、黑洞自旋 $a$ 与观测者倾角的依赖。结果表明，**三次曲率相互作用会产生可与 Kerr 阴影区分的偏离，改变阴影的表观大小与形状**；**两组三次曲率耦合对阴影边界具有不同效应，偏离幅度敏感依赖于耦合强度与黑洞自旋**。作者通过测地线积分和阴影边界判定的独立收敛性测试验证数值结果，并在耦合趋于零时恢复解析的 Kerr 阴影。该工作为强场区域的高阶曲率引力提供了互补检验途径，也展示了黑洞阴影观测约束广义相对论偏离的潜力。
summary: We investigate the effects of cubic curvature corrections on the shadows of rotating black holes within the effective field theory of gravity. Starting from a perturbatively corrected Kerr metric incorporating two independent cubic curvature couplings, we construct black hole shadows through numerical integration of null geodesics, without assuming separability of the geodesic equations. Using a Hamiltonian ray-tracing approach, we systematically examine the dependence of the shadow geometry on the higher-curvature couplings, black hole spin, and observer inclination. We find that cubic curvature interactions can produce discernible deviations from the Kerr shadow, modifying its apparent size and shape. In particular, the two cubic interactions exhibit distinct effects on the shadow boundary, with the magnitude of the deviations depending sensitively on the coupling strengths and black hole spin. We validate our numerical results through independent convergence tests of the geodesic integration and shadow-boundary determination, and recover the analytical Kerr shadow in the vanishing-coupling limit. Our results provide a complementary probe of higher-curvature gravity in the strong-field regime and illustrate the potential of black hole shadow observations to constrain departures from general relativity.

title: Cosmological Signals from Finite-Lifetime Domain Wall Networks
background_knowledge: 早期宇宙中的相变可通过自发对称性破缺留下拓扑缺陷；畴壁是由离散对称性破缺产生的二维面状缺陷。稳定畴壁的能量密度随膨胀衰减得比辐射慢，可能主导宇宙，因此宇宙学通常要求畴壁具有有限寿命，或由显式对称性破缺造成的能量偏置使其在网络主导之前坍缩。处于标度演化阶段的畴壁网络具有随宇宙时标增长的关联长度 $\xi \sim t$，其能量密度可写为 $\rho_{\rm DW} \sim \sigma/\xi$，其中 $\sigma$ 为畴壁张力；在辐射主导时期 $t \propto a^2$，故 $\rho_{\rm DW}$ 近似按 $a^{-2}$ 衰减，而辐射能量密度按 $a^{-4}$ 衰减。此类网络产生的标量与张量度规扰动会印在宇宙微波背景温度和偏振中，特别是张量扰动可产生 $B$ 模偏振。该方向的研究范式通常借助缺陷网络模型计算功率谱，再与 CMB、大尺度结构等观测限制比较，并联系粒子物理模型，如 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 对称性破缺和轴子模型。
contribution: 论文利用 unconnected segment model 研究亚稳畴壁网络产生的宇宙学扰动，在长波极限下推导出标量与张量功率谱的解析表达式，并发现标度演化期间二者振幅之间存在**固定比例**。这些功率谱随网络演化而增长，驱动因素包括关联长度不断增大以及畴壁能量密度相对辐射衰减更慢；功率谱在由网络坍缩时标决定的尺度上**达到峰值**。作者进一步将标量谱与观测限制比较，得到对坍缩时畴壁能量密度的限制，并将其应用于 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 与轴子模型。当这些限制被饱和时，对于张量-标量比 $r \sim 0.03$ 的情形，所产生的 CMB $B$ 模信号**可与暴胀产生的张量信号相当，甚至更大**，从而**有望进入未来 CMB 偏振实验的探测范围**。
summary: We study cosmological perturbations sourced by metastable domain wall (DW) networks. Using the unconnected segment model, we derive analytic expressions for the scalar and tensor power spectra in the long-wavelength regime, finding a fixed ratio between their amplitudes during the scaling regime. These spectra grow as the network evolves, driven by the increasing correlation length and slower redshifting of the wall energy density relative to radiation, and peak at a scale set by the network's collapse time. Comparing the scalar spectrum with observational constraints, we derive bounds on the DW energy density at collapse, which we apply to $\mathbb{Z}_2$ and axion models. When these bounds are saturated, the resulting CMB $B$-mode signal can be comparable to or larger than the inflationary signal for a tensor-to-scalar ratio $r \sim 0.03$, potentially bringing it within reach of future CMB polarization experiments.

title: Subpicosecond Optical Time Transfer under Simulated Motion with Electro-Optic Frequency Combs
background_knowledge: 高精度时间与频率传递是现代计量、深空导航、甚长基线干涉测量（VLBI）、脉冲星计时和引力波探测等系统的基础能力之一。其核心目标是让相距遥远的站点共享同一时间尺度：本地光学钟或微波钟产生高度稳定的频率基准，通过光纤或自由空间链路比对相位与到达时间。双向时间传递通过在两站间同时或交替发送信号并组合往返测量，可抵消链路长度抖动、温度漂移和部分公共噪声；但平台相对运动会产生多普勒频移、传播时延变化和动态链路延迟，使传统方案难以在高速运动下保持连续锁定。光学频率梳把窄线宽激光的相干性分配到大量梳齿上，可在光频与微波/数字信号之间建立相位相干桥梁；电光频率梳则利用电光调制产生梳齿，具有重频和偏频可快速编程调控的特点，适合模拟动态链路和构建敏捷传递系统。
contribution: 论文利用敏捷的电光频率梳在实验室中构建了一个模拟运动条件下双向光学时间传递的系统，通过对电光频率梳参数的直接控制人为引入相对运动效应。作者在 km 级光纤链路上测试了从静止线性增加到 $400\ \mathrm{m/s}$ 的速度剖面下的时间传递性能，并通过后处理数据分析证明：**在整个速度扫描过程中能够以亚皮秒精度连续跟踪两站之间的钟差**。该结果展示了电光频率梳用于实际部署系统中光学时间传递的灵活性与潜力。
summary: Extension of high performance optical frequency comb-based time transfer to real-world systems is challenged by platform motion, particularly for large relative velocities. Here, we utilize agile electro-optic frequency combs to construct a laboratory-based simulator of a two-way optical time transfer system under motion. Through direct control of the electro-optic frequency comb parameters, we can artificially induce the effects of relative motion. We performed tests of the time transfer performance across a km-scale fiber link for velocity profiles that linearly increase from rest up to 400 m/s. Through a post-processed data analysis, we demonstrate continuous tracking of the clock offset between sites with subpicosecond precision throughout the velocity sweep. These results illustrate the versatility of using electro-optic frequency combs for optical time transfer in deployed systems.

title: Euclid DR1 Legacy Science on Ultracool Dwarfs: Brown Dwarfs in the Blanco 1 Open Cluster
background_knowledge: 褐矮星是质量不足以维持稳定氢核聚变的亚恒星天体，通常以约 $0.075\,M_{\odot}$ 作为氢燃烧下限；其有效温度随年龄下降，光谱由晚 M 型过渡到 L 型、T 型，大气中可出现尘埃云、甲烷等特征。年轻疏散星团是研究褐矮星形成与演化及亚恒星质量函数的理想实验室：成员星近似同年龄、同距离、同金属丰度，可通过测光、光谱分类、长期自行和视差联合认证；对年轻（百 Myr 量级）且近邻的星团，褐矮星仍较亮，因而能在宽视场巡天中系统搜寻。研究范式通常包括：在星团天区选取晚 M/L/T 型候选体，利用多历元测光与天体测量计算自行和成员概率，借助光谱确认并分类，再用演化模型由光度、颜色和年龄反推质量，并将成员数目与给定初始质量函数或亚恒星质量函数的外推结果比较。Blanco 1 是南天年轻疏散星团，年龄约 100--130 Myr、距离约 $234\,\mathrm{pc}$，其外围和潮汐尾为检验星团动力学演化与低质量星族提供了窗口。Euclid 的宽视场成像和无缝光谱可在同一数据集中提供深测光、形态与光谱信息，再与地面巡天（如 VIKING、KiDS、Rubin、Subaru HSC）的历史位置结合，可显著扩展长基线自行测量和成员认证。
contribution: 论文利用覆盖年轻（100--130 Myr）近邻（$234\,\mathrm{pc}$）疏散星团 Blanco 1 部分冕区与潮汐尾的 $35.6\,\mathrm{deg}^2$ Euclid Data Release 1 天区，从 Euclid 测光与无缝光谱中选出 22 颗超冷矮星，并将 Euclid 天体测量与 VIKING、KiDS 和 Rubin 位置结合，在约 13 yr 的中位基线上测量自行。**在其中识别出 10 颗共动的晚 M 型与 L 型褐矮星成员候选体，两种背景场模型下成员概率均至少为 $0.5$**；其中 9 颗由 Euclid 光谱给出光谱型，第 10 颗仅在采用颜色推断光谱型时成立。按星团年龄并采用褐矮星演化模型，其质量约为 $0.03$--$0.06\,M_{\odot}$。**该亚恒星族群数量约为依据 Gaia 星团成员标定的对数正态质量函数所预言的两倍**。其余 12 颗被归类为晚 M、L 和 T 型矮星，但星团成员概率较低。作者进一步以 Euclid 样本校准对 $246\,\mathrm{deg}^2$ VIKING 与 KiDS 测光及自行数据的搜寻，得到 60 个超冷候选体，其中约 7 个预期来自偶然排列。对 Blanco 1 核心区，结合存档 Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam 图像与 2011--2025 年自行，得到 35 个 M7 型或更晚型候选体，**至少 20 个以 95% 置信度为运动学成员**。这些结果把 Blanco 1 的光谱序列延伸到 L 型褐矮星，并扩充了星团外围与潮汐尾的成员候选名单。
summary: A 35.6\,deg$^2$ field of Euclid Data Release~1 that covers part of the corona and tidal tails of the young (100--130\,Myr) nearby (234\,pc) open cluster Blanco~1 is presented. We select 22 ultracool dwarfs from Euclid photometry and slitless spectra, and measure proper motions over a median baseline of 13\,yr by combining Euclid astrometry with VIKING, KiDS and Rubin positions. Ten objects are comoving late-M and L dwarf candidates with membership probabilities of at least 0.5 under two field models. Nine of them are typed from their Euclid spectra, and the tenth is a candidate only if its colour-based type is adopted. Brown dwarf evolutionary models give masses of 0.03--0.06\,$M_\odot$ for the cluster age. The substellar population is about twice that predicted by a lognormal mass function scaled to the cluster's Gaia members. The remaining 12 objects are classified as late-M, L and T dwarfs with low probability of membership in the cluster. Using the Euclid sample to calibrate a search over 246\,deg$^2$ of VIKING and KiDS photometry and motions, we identify 60 ultracool candidates, with about seven expected by chance. In the core region of Blanco 1 archival Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam images and motions over 2011--2025 yield 35 candidates of types M7 or later, at least 20 of which are kinematic members at 95\% confidence. These results extend the spectroscopic sequence of Blanco 1 into the L-type brown dwarfs and the list of candidate members over the outskirts and tidal tails of the cluster.

title: Can we constrain cosmology with compound gravitational lenses?
background_knowledge: 强引力透镜是指前景大质量星系或星系团使背景源的光线发生偏折，从而产生多重像、爱因斯坦环或弧。爱因斯坦半径 $\theta_{\rm E} = \sqrt{4GM D_{\rm ls}/(c^2 D_{\rm l}D_{\rm s})}$ 依赖于透镜质量以及源、透镜和观测者之间的角直径距离；因此，测量得到的距离比 $\beta = D_{\rm ls}/D_{\rm s}$ 可用于约束宇宙学。双源平面透镜（double-source-plane lenses, DSPLs）中，同一前景透镜同时透镜两个不同红移的背景源，因而可提供多个距离比。若第一个源本身具有不可忽略的质量，它还会作为第二个源的额外透镜，形成复合透镜。复合透镜能增加宇宙学信息，但也带来质量片变换（mass-sheet transformation, MST）简并：在透镜平面加入均匀收敛并缩放源平面，像的位置可保持不变，而推断出的距离比和宇宙学参数会系统偏移。控制或消除这一简并，是强透镜宇宙学需要解决的核心问题之一。
contribution: 该工作利用基于 SDSS J0946+1006 的模拟观测研究复合透镜中的系统偏差，并通过改变第一个源的质量分布来检验其对距离比 $\beta$ 反演的影响。结果发现，第一个源的恒星质量与暗晕质量之比同反演得到的 $\beta$ 之间存在**强相关性**。作者进一步构建了 Euclid 望远镜可探测的 DSPL 模拟目录，以检验该相关偏差是否在更多样化的样本中传播；但在 Euclid 的分辨率下，第一个源的性质约束较差，相关偏差被统计不确定性掩盖。利用 $\beta$ 后验，作者对平坦 $w$CDM 宇宙学推断 $w_0$ 与 $\Omega_{\rm m}$，发现使用完整 Euclid 模拟样本时宇宙学参数存在偏差；采用经过良好建模的有限“gold”子样本后，偏差显著减小，对模拟 Euclid 与 Hubble Space Telescope（HST）成像分别达到基准真实宇宙学的约 $2\sigma$ 与 $1\sigma$ 以内。因此，必须剔除透镜信息不可靠的系统；对于极端复合透镜，模型复杂度需足以重现透镜观测。**DSPLs 仍是很有前景的宇宙学探针**，可为现有探针提供独立且互补的限制。
summary: Compound lensing in double-source-plane lenses (DSPLs) introduces multiple mass-sheet transformations that bias the inferred distance ratios $β$ used to constrain cosmology. We present the recovered $β$ from lens models of simulated compound lenses and explore the systematic biases that arise from a mass-sheet transformation in the first source plane. We examined simulated observations based on SDSS J0946+1006, in which we varied the matter distribution of source 1. We found a strong correlation between the stellar-to-halo mass and the recovered $β$. We produced a simulated catalogue of DSPLs detectable by the Euclid telescope to see if the same systematic propagates to a more varied population. But at Euclid's resolution, the properties of source 1 were poorly constrained, and any correlated bias was lost in the statistical uncertainty. We inferred $w_0$ and $Ω_{\rm m}$ for a flat $w$CDM cosmology from our $β$ posteriors for our combined sample. We found the cosmology biased when using the full mock Euclid sample, but reduced the bias substantially using a limited, well-modelled ''gold'' sub-sample, bringing it to within $\sim2σ$ and $\sim1σ$ of the ground-truth cosmology for simulated Euclid and Hubble Space Telescope imaging, respectively. Therefore, we must eliminate systems with unreliable lensing information, and for extreme compound lensing, the model complexity must be sufficient to reproduce the lensing observations. DSPLs remain a promising cosmological probe that could provide independent and complementary constraints to existing probes.

title: Tracing Galactic Dust Reddening with Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbon Emission: SPHEREx Observations of the North Ecliptic Pole
background_knowledge: 银河系星际介质中的尘埃会吸收和散射星光，使观测到的恒星颜色整体变红；这一效应通常用色余 $E(B-V)$ 或消光 $A_V$ 描述，是校正天体测光、研究银河系尘埃分布和解释背景宇宙学信号的基础。尘埃在紫外至可见光波段消光显著，在红外波段则吸收星光后重新辐射，并在多环芳香烃（PAH）的 $3.3\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ 等特征上产生发射。PAH 发射强度与尘埃含量、辐射场强度和 PAH 丰度有关，因此可作为一种红化示踪剂，但需要辐射场修正和定标。传统银河系红化图常基于远红外尘埃热辐射、恒星测光红化和 $21\,\mathrm{cm}$ 中性氢（HI）观测；在高银纬弥散区，信号较弱、尘埃与气体关系可能变化、辐射场和 PAH 丰度存在系统差异，且角分辨率与天区覆盖各有取舍。SPHEREx 提供近红外光谱成像，可在较大天区上逐像素测量 PAH 特征，从而探索高角分辨率红化制图的研究范式。
contribution: 作者利用 SPHEREx 对以北黄极（NEP）为中心、约 $22^{\circ}\times22^{\circ}$ 区域的观测，在每个 $6''.2$ 像素上采用基于光谱模板的方法测量 $3.3\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ PAH 发射特征强度，并通过辐射场修正与线性比例因子将该特征强度转换为红化 $E(B-V)$。所得红化图在角分级尺度上与远红外、恒星测光和 HI 红化图一致，典型 $E(B-V)$ 差异为 $\lesssim 7$ mmag。星系计数检验表明，所有红化图相对于产生空间均匀星系计数所需值均有约 $11$ mmag 的 $E(B-V)$ 弥散；高 PAH 丰度区可能存在红化高估，但该效应小于辐射场修正的不确定度，且在最极端区域仅约 $10$ mmag。**在 NEP 这类高银纬弥散区及本文验证指标的灵敏度下，基于 SPHEREx PAH 发射的红化图达到现有红化图的精度，同时可达到约 $6''$ 的更高角分辨率。**
summary: We investigate the ability of SPHEREx observations of the $3.3$ $μ$m polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) emission feature to trace Galactic dust reddening. Applying a spectral template-based method to SPHEREx data, we measure the strength of the $3.3$ $μ$m PAH feature in each $6''.2$ pixel of a $22^{\circ}$ by $22^{\circ}$ region centered on the north ecliptic pole (NEP). We convert the PAH feature strength to reddening by applying a radiation field correction and a linear scale factor. The resulting $E(B-V)$ map is consistent with far-infrared, stellar, and HI-based reddening maps at arcminute scales, exhibiting a typical $E(B-V)$ difference of $\lesssim 7$ mmag. A galaxy count test finds that all reddening maps have a dispersion of $\approx11$ mmag in $E(B-V)$ relative to what would be needed to produce spatially uniform galaxy counts. While there is some evidence that reddening is overestimated by our map at high PAH abundances, this effect is smaller than the uncertainties on the applied radiation field corrections and limited to $\sim$10 mmag in the most extreme regions of the NEP. For a diffuse, high Galactic latitude region like the NEP and at the sensitivities of our validation metrics, the SPHEREx PAH-emission based reddening map matches the accuracy of existing reddening maps while being capable of accessing a higher angular resolution of $\sim6''$.

title: The NANOGrav 15-year data set: A Limit on Continuous Spin Gravitons
background_knowledge: 在粒子物理与引力物理中，无质量粒子的自旋（螺旋度）通常由洛伦兹群的表示固定：光子对应螺旋度 $\pm 1$，引力子对应 $\pm 2$。连续自旋粒子（continuous spin particles, CSPs）是一类特殊的无质量表示，用一个有量纲的自旋尺度 $\rho$ 标记；当 $\rho \neq 0$ 时，粒子在洛伦兹助推下螺旋度不再固定，而发生混合。由于 $\rho \rightarrow 0$ 时 CSPs 退化为普通无质量粒子，光子和引力子也可能只是因 $\rho$ 很小而“看起来”像普通粒子。近期理论工作表明，在 $\rho \ll \omega$ 时，CSPs 的物理效应按 $\rho/\omega$ 的幂次压低，其中 $\omega$ 是频率尺度，因此低频探测对这类效应尤其敏感。脉冲星计时阵列（pulsar timing arrays, PTAs）通过长期监测多颗毫秒脉冲星的脉冲到达时间，寻找脉冲到达时间残差中的空间相关信号，是探测纳赫兹引力波的主要手段；NANOGrav 15 年数据最近给出了随机引力波背景的证据。该方向通常采用贝叶斯数据分析，将理论预测的时间残差协方差与观测数据比较，从而对引力波背景的极化、传播速度、质量以及引力子自旋等基本性质给出限制。
contribution: 论文将连续自旋引力子的理论效应用于脉冲星计时阵列分析，利用 NANOGrav 15 年数据对引力子自旋尺度 $\rho_\text{g}$ 给出贝叶斯限制。由于 CSPs 的低频效应随 $\rho/\omega$ 的幂次变化，PTAs 对纳赫兹引力波的高灵敏度使其成为理想探针。作者采用标准贝叶斯数据分析，在 95% 可信水平下得到 **$\rho_\text{g} < 1.23 \times 10^{-23} \, \text{eV}$**。该结果表明，若引力子具有连续自旋结构，其自旋尺度必须极小，从而在当前观测精度下与普通无质量引力子高度一致。
summary: Continuous spin particles (CSPs) are massless particles characterized by a dimensionful spin scale, $ρ$, which, when non-zero, changes their helicity under Lorentz boosts. Since CSPs reduce to ordinary particles when $ρ\rightarrow 0$, the photon or graviton could be CSPs and only appear to behave as ordinary particles due to a small value of $ρ$. Therefore, it is important to determine what value of $ρ$ is experimentally allowed. Recent work has shown that the physical effects of CSPs scale as powers of $ρ/ω$ when $ρ\ll ω$, where $ω$ is a frequency scale, making low-frequency probes particularly beneficial for highlighting these phenomena. In this paper we use pulsar timing arrays to set constraints on the spin scale of the continuous spin graviton. Pulsar timing arrays are uniquely suited for this application as they have exceptional sensitivity to low, nanohertz frequency gravitational waves, as demonstrated by their recent evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background. Using standard Bayesian data analysis techniques, we find that the NANOGrav 15-year data set constrains the graviton spin scale to $ρ_\text{g} < 1.23 \times 10^{-23} \, \text{eV} $ at the 95% credible level.

title: Transient early reionization allows for a high optical depth while remaining consistent with kSZ measurements
background_knowledge: 宇宙微波背景（CMB）在复合后自由传播；第一代恒星和星系产生的紫外辐射使氢再电离，自由电子通过 Thomson 散射抑制 CMB 偏振，积分光学深度 $\tau=\int n_e\sigma_T c\,dt$ 因此记录自由电子柱密度。$\tau$ 与 CMB 标量振幅存在简并，并影响暗能量、中微子质量等宇宙学参数推断。Planck 低 $\ell$ 偏振给出 $\tau\approx0.054$；若真实 $\tau$ 更高，DESI 对动力学暗能量和低中微子质量的偏好会减弱。动理学 Sunyaev--Zel'dovich（kSZ）效应来自 CMB 光子与被电离气体中运动电子的散射，对再电离的持续时间和 patchy 结构敏感；与 Ly$\alpha$ 森林测得的再电离结束红移结合，可限制 $\tau$。Ly$\alpha$ 森林通过中性氢吸收测量宇宙中性氢含量和再电离末期。Population III 星是低金属丰度、早期形成的大质量恒星，其中超大质量成员可在高红移短暂部分电离星系际介质（IGM），提供额外电子而不必违反晚期再电离约束。
contribution: 本文采用一个新的、自洽的超大质量 Population III 星模型：这些恒星在 $z\approx20$--$25$ 部分电离星系际介质（IGM），并据此预言 kSZ 信号。作者表明，这种**早期、瞬时的再电离阶段可以把 $\tau$ 提高到约 0.09，同时仍与当前 kSZ 和 Ly$\alpha$ 森林限制相容**，从而缓解低 $\tau$ 与 DESI 偏好之间的张力。文章进一步预言，Simons Observatory 结合 Ly$\alpha$ 森林和紫外光度函数数据，在其基准（fiducial）超大质量 Pop III 情景下，可将 $z=12$ 以上累积的光学深度限制到 **$\pm0.008$**。
summary: Recent works have shown that a CMB optical depth of $τ\approx0.09$, above the Planck low-$\ell$ polarization value of 0.054, would weaken the preference of DESI data for dynamical dark energy and for a low neutrino mass. Apart from the low-$\ell$ CMB, another probe that prefers a $τ\sim0.055$ is the kinetic Sunyaev--Zel'dovich (kSZ) effect when combined with the end of hydrogen reionization as measured by the Ly$α$ forest. In this work we use a new self-consistent model of supermassive Population~III stars, which partially ionize the intergalactic medium at high redshifts ($z\approx20$--$25$), to predict the kSZ signal. We show that such an early, transient reionization phase can raise $τ$ to $\approx0.09$ while remaining consistent with current kSZ and Ly-$α$ forest constraints. We forecast that the Simons Observatory, combined with Ly-$α$ forest and UV luminosity function data, can constrain the optical depth accumulated above $z=12$ to $\pm0.008$ in our fiducial supermassive Pop~III scenario.

title: Mass Loss Rates of Evolved Stars in Isolated Dwarf Galaxies
background_knowledge: 矮不规则星系质量小、金属丰度低且常处于孤立环境，是研究恒星演化、星际介质增丰与尘埃预算的天然实验室。渐近巨星分支（AGB）星是低至中等质量恒星演化的晚期阶段，具有低温、明亮且延展的包层；脉动、辐射压和激波等机制可驱动显著的质量损失，把富碳或富氧气体与尘粒抛射到星际介质中。观测上通常由多波段测光构建光谱能量分布（SED），结合尘埃辐射模型反演质量损失率和产尘率。星系尘埃可由 AGB 星风、超新星抛射以及星际介质中的尘粒生长等过程供给；比较各来源的贡献与由红外/亚毫米观测得到的总尘埃质量，是判断尘埃预算是否闭合的关键。
contribution: 本文利用自动化管线 SEDust 对孤立矮不规则星系 NGC 6822 中 AGB 星的光谱能量分布进行拟合，估计其质量损失率与产尘率。该 AGB 星族的总质量损失率为 $(3.7 \pm 1.1) \times 10^{-3}\,M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$；取气体与尘埃质量比为 $200$ 时，对应尘埃注入率为 $2.0 \times 10^{-5}\,M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$。若该速率维持 $10\,\mathrm{Gyr}$，累计可产生约 $2 \times 10^{5}\,M_\odot$ 的尘埃，**低于 Herschel 观测估计的 $2.7 \times 10^{5}\,M_\odot$ 尘埃质量**。因此，**仅靠 AGB 星无法解释 NGC 6822 现今的尘埃储量，需要额外尘埃来源或过程，例如星际介质中的尘粒生长**。
summary: We derive the mass-loss rates of asymptotic giant branch (AGB) stars in the isolated dwarf irregular galaxy NGC 6822 using SEDust, an automated pipeline that fits spectral energy distributions (SEDs) to estimate stellar mass-loss and dust-production rates. The total mass-loss rate of the AGB population is $(3.7 \pm 1.1) \times 10^{-3} M_\odot\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$. For a gas-to-dust ratio of 200, this corresponds to a dust injection rate of $2.0 \times 10^{-5} M_\odot\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$. If sustained over 10 Gyr, this rate would yield approximately $2 \times 10^{5} M_\odot$ of dust, which is lower than the dust mass of $2.7 \times 10^{5} M_\odot$ estimated from Herschel observations. AGB stars alone therefore cannot account for the present-day dust reservoir of NGC 6822, and additional sources or processes, such as dust growth in the interstellar medium, are required.

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). NISP spectroscopy of gravitational arcs and multiple images
background_knowledge: 强引力透镜效应是指前景大质量天体（如星系团或星系）的引力场弯曲背景源发出的光，从而在观测上产生巨弧、多重像或爱因斯坦环。它是测量透镜质量分布、约束宇宙学参数和研究高红移背景源的重要工具。可靠的强透镜模型通常需要两类关键观测量：一是多重像或弧的精确天球位置，二是背景源的光谱红移；后者直接影响源平面距离、质量模型和宇宙学推断。星系团尺度透镜常产生巨弧，星系尺度透镜可产生爱因斯坦环，而四重成像的 AGN 则可用于限制透镜势与哈勃常数等。无狭缝光谱（slitless spectroscopy）能够在大视场内同时对大量天体获得光谱，通过检测发射线并重建发射线图像来测定红移。Euclid 同时提供高分辨率多波段成像和近红外无缝光谱，因而适合系统搜寻并刻画大样本强引力透镜。
contribution: 本文利用 Euclid 无狭缝光谱数据测定了四个空间延展的强透镜源的红移，并重建了其发射线图像。两个目标分别被大质量星系团 SPT-CLJ0411-4819（$z_\mathrm{d}=0.424$）和 Abell 2280（$z_\mathrm{d}=0.326$）透镜成巨弧；第三个是由 $z_\mathrm{d}=0.68$ 的大质量星系强透镜的四重成像 AGN 候选；第四个是由 $z_\mathrm{d}=0.235$ 的透镜星系产生的星系尺度爱因斯坦环。**该工作是 Euclid 无狭缝光谱用于强引力透镜研究的原理验证，并给出了首批基于 NISP 光谱的强透镜特征光谱红移测定之一。** **结果证明，同一方法可推广到 Euclid 已开始发现并将在任务期内预期识别的大样本引力透镜。**
summary: Applications of strong gravitational lensing in astrophysics and cosmology critically depend on building reliable strong lensing models, which require accurate measurements of on-sky positions of multiple images and of the redshifts of the background sources from which they originate. In this context, Euclid is a unique facility, as it simultaneously provides high-resolution multi-band photometric imaging and slitless spectroscopy for an unprecedentedly large sample of gravitational lenses, most of which are newly discovered. In this work, we exploit Euclid slitless spectroscopic data to determine the redshifts of four spatially extended lensed sources, and to reconstruct emission-line images. Specifically, two of the target sources are lensed into giant arcs by the massive galaxy clusters SPT-CLJ0411$-$4819 ($z_\mathrm{d}=0.424$, where "d" denotes the lensing deflector) and Abell 2280 ($z_\mathrm{d}=0.326$). The third system is a quadruply imaged active galactic nucleus (AGN) candidate strongly lensed by a massive galaxy at $z_\mathrm{d}=0.68$, while the fourth is a galaxy-scale Einstein ring produced by a lens galaxy at $z_\mathrm{d}=0.235$. This work represents a proof of concept for the exploitation of Euclid slitless spectroscopic data in the study of strong gravitational lensing, providing one of the first determinations of spectroscopic redshifts for strongly lensed features from NISP spectra. These results demonstrate the feasibility of applying the same methodology to the very large sample of gravitational lenses that Euclid has started to discover and is expected to identify over the course of the mission.

title: C$_2$ Swan, CH and CN emission, surface temperature and luminous efficiency of the Hayabusa2 sample-return capsule from ground-based spectroscopy
background_knowledge: 该工作属于行星大气再入光谱学与流星物理的交叉方向。当返回舱、流星体等以高超音速进入大气时，前方形成强激波和高温激波层（shock layer），气体分子被激发、解离甚至电离；光谱中可出现 CN 紫系统、CH $A$-$X$ 带与 $C_2$ Swan 带等分子带，以及来自高温表面的连续谱。通过测量分子带的转动温度与振动温度、表面色温和总辐射能量，可以反演激波层热化学、烧蚀过程与边界层物理，并估计发光效率。对人工返回舱而言，碳-酚醛烧蚀防热层在受热早期发生热解，向边界层注入含碳物种，使其发射特征与天然火流星既有相似也有差异；地面无狭缝光谱视频能以较低成本记录这些时间演化。
contribution: 论文利用地面手持跟踪的消费级相机拍摄的无狭缝光谱视频，在 80 至 49 km 高度段单独记录 Hayabusa2 返回舱再入，并分析其加热最初约 10 s 的分子发射。观测到 CN 紫系统、CH $A$-$X$ 带和 $C_2$ Swan 带；**其中 $C_2$ Swan 带系首次在返回舱再入的远程观测中被探测到**。拟合得到 $C_2$ 的转动温度约 $T_{\rm rot}\approx 9200\ \mathrm{K}$、振动温度约 $T_{\rm vib}\approx 7800\ \mathrm{K}$，CN 约 $7000\ \mathrm{K}$，**均远高于舱体表面温度**。$C_2$ 与 CH 在热流仍上升时消失而 CN 持续存在，作者将其与碳-酚醛烧蚀层的早期热解及边界层化学随时间变化联系起来。热防护罩的色温由 $2720\ \mathrm{K}$ 升至 $3080\ \mathrm{K}$，与机载观测结果一致。**其辐射能量比天然火流星低一到两个数量级，因为光主要来自高温表面而非烧蚀蒸气**，这对理解返回舱再入的发光效率具有重要意义。返回舱通过后约 $1\ \mathrm{s}$ 出现一条微弱余迹，并在数秒内消退，可能源于冷却尾流中的化学发光。
summary: The Hayabusa2 sample-return capsule entered the atmosphere over South Australia on 5 December 2020 at 12 km/s. A slitless spectral video, taken from the ground with a hand-tracked consumer camera, shows the capsule alone from 80 to 49 km. In the first ten seconds of heating the shock layer emits the CN violet system, the CH A-X band and the C$_2$ Swan bands, the latter for the first time in remote observations of a capsule entry. C$_2$ ($T_{\rm rot}\approx9200$ K, $T_{\rm vib}\approx7800$ K) and CN (about 7000 K) are far hotter than the surface. C$_2$ and CH disappear while the heat flux is still rising and CN persists, which we relate to the early pyrolysis of the carbon-phenolic ablator and to the changing boundary-layer chemistry. The colour temperature of the heat shield rises from 2720 to 3080 K, in agreement with airborne results. The radiated energy is one to two orders of magnitude below that of natural fireballs, because the light comes from the hot surface rather than from ablation vapour. A faint persistent train lights up about 1 s after the passage and fades within a few seconds, probably chemiluminescence in the cooling wake.

title: Development of millikelvin scintillation photodetectors with CUPID
background_knowledge: 该工作属于稀有事例搜寻与中微子物理实验方向，而非传统天体物理观测。无中微子双贝塔衰变 $0\nu\beta\beta$ 是一种假想核衰变：原子核中的两个中子转变为两个质子并放出两个电子，但不放出中微子。若被发现，它将破坏轻子数守恒，并证明中微子是 Majorana 粒子，是超出标准模型新物理的重要证据。实验上需要在极低本底下积累大质量目标同位素，同时具备高能量分辨率和强背景甄别能力。CUPID 采用低温量热器方案：目标同位素嵌入闪烁晶体 Li$_2$MoO$_4$ 中，粒子沉积能量引起的微小温升由极低温传感器读出。闪烁光可用于区分不同粒子并排除堆积事例，因为光产额随粒子种类变化；因此需要低阈值、高信噪比的低温光探测器。高纯锗晶片可吸收闪烁光，并在偏压下利用 Neganov-Trofimov-Luke 效应把电荷漂移产生的额外热信号放大，从而提升光探测灵敏度。
contribution: 本文面向下一代吨级实验 CUPID，该实验将在意大利 Gran Sasso National Laboratory 搜寻 $^{100}\mathrm{Mo}$ 的 $0\nu\beta\beta$ 衰变。CUPID 使用 Li$_2$MoO$_4$ 闪烁晶体的低温量热技术重建能量沉积。作者报告了 CUPID VSTT（Vertical Slice Test Tower）原型塔的初步测量：该原型用于检验探测器响应以及装置的机械与热稳定性，另一关键目标是验证基于锗的低温光探测器性能的提升。CUPID 利用光探测进行粒子鉴别与堆积排除：Li$_2$MoO$_4$ 的闪烁光峰值约 $\sim$600 nm，由紧邻晶体的约 $\sim$300 $\mu$m 厚高纯锗晶片收集；晶片上设有同心 Al 电极并施加几十伏偏压，借助 Neganov-Trofimov-Luke 效应使信噪比提高约一个量级。本文给出了 VSTT 光探测器及其光学注入系统的初步性能结果，**报道了该低温光读出方案在 CUPID 原型中的初步验证进展，并展示了 NTL 增强对光探测信噪比的显著提升**。
summary: CUPID is a next-generation tonne-scale cryogenic experiment that will search for the neutrinoless double beta decay $(0νββ)$ of $^{100}$Mo. It will be located at the Gran Sasso National Laboratory (Italy) and will employ the cryogenic calorimetric technique to reconstruct the energy deposited in Li$_{2}$MoO$_{4}$ crystals, in which the isotope of interest is embedded. Preliminary measurements have been performed with the CUPID VSTT (Vertical Slice Test Tower), a prototype tower designed to test the detectors' response and the apparatus' mechanical and thermal stability. In addition, a key objective was to demonstrate the improved performance of germanium-based cryogenic light detectors. In CUPID, light detection is used for both particle identification and pile-up rejection. Li$_{2}$MoO$_{4}$ is a scintillating crystal, enabling particle identification by exploiting the dependence of light yield on particle type. This requires collecting the Li$_{2}$MoO$_{4}$ scintillation light, peaking at $\sim$600 nm, with a $\sim$300 $μ$m-thick high-purity germanium wafer placed next to the crystal. The wafer is also equipped with concentric Al electrodes biased at a few tens of volts. This bias improves the signal-to-noise ratio by an order of magnitude thanks to the Neganov-Trofimov-Luke effect. This work presents preliminary results on the performance of the VSTT light detectors and of its Optical Injection System.

title: Efficient Standard Siren Cosmological Inference with Posterior Reuse
background_knowledge: 标准汽笛（standard siren）是指通过引力波观测来测量宇宙距离的一类源：双致密星并合产生的引力波波形可给出源的光度距离 $d_L$；若再独立获得源的红移 $z$，便可通过 $d_L(z)$ 关系测量宇宙膨胀历史，尤其是哈勃常数 $H_0$ 以及暗能量性质。明亮汽笛具有电磁对应体，可直接定出宿主星系红移；暗汽笛没有电磁对应体，需借助星系目录和引力波天区定位，以统计方式推断宿主星系红移。此类分析通常采用分层贝叶斯推断，同时建模源的质量、自旋等族群分布，星系目录的完备性与测距误差，以及探测选择效应，并从引力波事件集合中联合约束宇宙学参数与族群参数。随着 GWTC 等引力波星表逐步扩大，重复分析高度重叠的数据、逐一检验建模假设会带来巨大的计算开销；因此，发展可复用后验、快速更新推断的采样方法成为该领域的重要方法学方向。
contribution: 论文将新近发展的 ASPIRE（Accelerated Sequential Posterior Inference via Reuse）采样器用于暗汽笛的宇宙学参数与族群参数联合估计。ASPIRE 不从头开始，也不从先验重新采样，而是把已有后验样本更新为新假设下的后验；它结合标准化流（normalising flows）与序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方案，给出准确后验和无偏证据估计。作者对 GWTC-5.0 的多个暗汽笛分析案例进行检验，发现所得后验与嵌套采样（nested sampling）一致，并在使用已有后验时相对整套分析取得 **6–28 倍** 的性能提升。该工作使研究者能够高效探索不同建模选择，并在引力波星表增长时快速更新结果，而无需重复已有计算。
summary: Standard siren cosmology depends on several modelling assumptions, including the underlying source population, galaxy catalogue, and detection selection function. Quantifying the effect of each choice typically requires a full, independent analysis. As gravitational-wave catalogs grow incrementally, much computational effort is spent re-analysing largely overlapping datasets. We apply the recently developed ASPIRE (Accelerated Sequential Posterior Inference via Reuse) sampler to the joint estimation of cosmological and population parameters with dark sirens. ASPIRE updates existing posterior samples into the posterior under a new hypothesis without restarting from the prior. It combines normalising flows with a sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) scheme to produce accurate posteriors and unbiased evidence estimates. Applying ASPIRE to a number of dark siren analysis cases with GWTC-5.0, we recover posteriors consistent with nested sampling, while recording a performance improvement of between 6-28 times over the set of analyses when using an existing posterior. This enables efficient exploration of modelling choices and rapid updates as catalogs grow, without duplicating existing computational effort.

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1) Euclid photometric masks
background_knowledge: 欧几里得（Euclid）是欧洲空间局主导的宇宙学空间望远镜，核心目标是通过高分辨率成像与光谱测量研究暗物质、暗能量以及宇宙大尺度结构的演化。其成像巡天在近红外波段获得大面积、高角分辨率的天体测光样本；要让这些样本可用于宇宙学，必须精确刻画巡天的空间非均匀性：不同天区的曝光时间、拼接方式、卫星姿态、点源函数（PSF）宽度、背景天光（如黄道光）、银河系消光、系统误差和质量标记都会改变探测深度与天体选择函数。现代巡天通常将这类信息编码为掩膜（mask），并以 HEALPix 等球面像素化方案提供；有效覆盖掩膜用来定义真正可用的巡天面积，并剔除伪源、边缘效应或质量不合格区域。掩膜因此是把原始观测转化为统计上可控科学样本的基础设施，对星系聚类、弱引力透镜、星系团和宇宙学参数推断都至关重要。
contribution: 本文给出 Euclid DR1 的光度掩膜，逐天区（tile）记录并量化巡天属性、仪器性能、外部数据质量以及天光污染等空间变化，包括卫星位置角、积分时间、天空拼接与巡天足迹，巡天覆盖、深度、PSF 宽度、质量标记、系统效应与天体测量不确定度，以及银河系消光和黄道光发射等污染。**有效覆盖掩膜尤为关键，它定义有效巡天面积，并可用于在选择 Euclid 光度样本时排除伪源。** 掩膜覆盖 EWS 与 EDS，以全天 HEALPix 图提供（nested 排序、显式索引），$N_{\rm side}=16384$，对应分辨率 $12.88^{\prime\prime}$。作者估计 DR1 EWS 和 EDS 的总面积分别为 $2008.8\ \mathrm{deg}^2$ 与 $74.7\ \mathrm{deg}^2$，其中分别有 82% 与 81% 的面积被有效覆盖掩膜保留。Euclid 的仪器性质与预期一致，仅呈现较小的天区相对变化；对 EWS，在 $2^{\prime\prime}$ 孔径和 $5\sigma$ 条件下，深度的标准差小于 $0.2\ \mathrm{AB\ mag}$，IE、YE、JE、HE 波段的中位深度分别为 25.69、24.14、24.3 与 24.29。**这些光度掩膜将成为许多科学应用、尤其是宇宙学分析的关键基础。**
summary: This paper describes the Euclid DR1 photometric masks, which trace spatial variations in the survey properties (e.g. satellite position angles, integration time, sky tiling, and survey footprint); in the instrumental performance of Euclid and the external data (EXT) it uses (e.g. survey coverage, depth, PSF width, quality flags, systematic effects and astrometric uncertainties); and in possible contamination from sky emission (e.g. galactic extinction and zodiacal light emission). Among this, the effective coverage mask is particularly important as it defines the effective survey area and can be used to exclude spurious objects when selecting Euclid photometric samples for scientific analyses. The Euclid photometric masks are built for each observed sky region (tile) and are provided as full-sky HEALPix maps (nested ordering and explicit indexing) at Nside = 16 384, equating to a resolution of 12"88, for both the Euclid Wide Survey (EWS) and Euclid Deep Survey (EDS). We estimate the total area of the DR1 EWS (EDS) to be 2008.8 (74.7) deg$^2$ and find that 82 (81)\% of this area is preserved by the effective coverage mask. We observe that Euclid's instrumental properties are consistent with expectations, showing only minor relative variations across the sky. For DR1 EWS the standard deviation of the depth (computed for a 2" aperture and at 5 $σ$) is below 0.2 AB mag, with median values of 25.69, 24.14, 24.3, and 24.29 for the Euclid IE, YE, JE, and HE bands. Finally, we expect these photometric masks to be key to many science applications and in particular for cosmological analyses.

title: Direct estimation of the lunar-solar precession with geodetic very long baseline interferometry
background_knowledge: 该工作属于大地测量 VLBI、地球自转与天球参考架连接方向，核心物理图像是：地球为扁球体，月球和太阳对地球赤道隆起施加引力矩，使地球自转轴在空间中缓慢进动，并叠加周期性章动；液体外核与地幔的不同转动还会产生自由核章动（FCN）。大地测量 VLBI 通过接收河外射电源信号，测量不同台站间的几何延迟与延迟率，从而反演台站坐标、地球定向参数以及天球—地球参考架之间的转换。常用坐标框架包括地固的国际地球参考系统（ITRS）和准惯性的地心天球参考系统（GCRS）；二者转换涉及岁差—章动、地球自转和极移。IAU2006 等传统模型通常采用天球中间极（CIP）和非旋转原点来描述转换，而瞬时自转极（IRP）则直接表征地球瞬时自转轴方向。VLBI 延迟率对地球自转轴方向随时间的变化敏感，因此可用于独立检验或估计岁差参数。
contribution: 论文利用大地测量 VLBI 的延迟率观测测量地球瞬时自转极分量 $X_{\mathrm{IRP}}$ 与 $Y_{\mathrm{IRP}}$，并对二者的多项式展开系数做最小二乘拟合，从而**不依赖行星运动理论直接估计岁差模型参数**；同时结合章动系数以及由 VLBI 群延迟得到的 FCN 效应，构建从 IRP 到 GCRS 的完整、简单解析转换模型，并给出基于观测结果的 ITRS 到 GCRS 经验模型。该模型与 IAU2006 类似地产生 $X_{\mathrm{IRP}}$、$Y_{\mathrm{IRP}}$ 时间序列，但这两个角指向 IRP 而非 CIP，因此在构造转换矩阵时无需引入非旋转原点概念；该解析模型可定义观测时段内任意历元的 IRP 位置。**基于 VLBI 延迟率分析得到的日月岁差参数为 $\psi_A=5038.500\pm0.019^{\prime\prime}/\mathrm{cy}$（参考历元 2000.0），与 IAU2006 采用的 $5038.4815^{\prime\prime}/\mathrm{cy}$ 接近。**
summary: Geodetic very long baseline interferometry (VLBI) is capable of measuring the Earth's instantaneous rotation pole (IRP) components (hereafter, $X_{IRP}$ and $Y_{IRP}$) with sufficient accuracy using the VLBI delay rate. The least-squares fit of the $X_{IRP}$ and $Y_{IRP}$ polynomial expansion coefficients produces the precession model parameters independently of planetary motion theories. Our aim was to estimate the precession parameters using VLBI delay rate observations as well as the nutation coefficients in order to produce a full transformation matrix from the IRP to the Geocentric Celestial Reference System (GCRS). Then, the goal was to incorporate the free core nutation (FCN) effect from the VLBI group delay to form a complete and simple analytical model. We obtained an empirical model of the transformation from International Terrestrial Reference System (ITRS) to Geocentric Celestial Reference System (GCRS) based on observational results. Similar to the IAU2006 theory, the new model produces time series of $X_{IRP}$ and $Y_{IRP}$ angles, but these two angles now point out the direction of the IRP rather than the celestial intermediate pole (CIP). A simple analytical model defines the IRP location for any epoch during the interval of observations. Therefore, the non-rotation origin concept is not required for the transformation matrix construction. The estimate of the lunar-solar precessional parameter based on analysis of VLBI delay rate is $ψ_{A}= 5038.500\pm 0.019"$/cy (referred to the observational epoch 2000.0), which is close to the adopted IAU2006 precessional parameter value $ψ_{A}= 5038.4815"$/cy.

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). An overview of the Science Ground Segment architecture and operations
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学标准模型为 ΛCDM 模型：当前宇宙的能量组成中约 95% 由暗能量与暗物质主导，因而理解暗能量的性质、检验引力理论以及刻画暗物质的大尺度分布，是宇宙学与星系形成研究的关键问题。Euclid 是欧洲空间局（ESA）的一项中型任务，计划通过大范围河外巡天并辅以深场观测，测量大量星系的形状、测光红移与光谱红移，从而利用弱引力透镜、星系成团和重子声学振荡等探针限制暗能量状态方程 $w$ 及修改引力模型。此类大规模巡天会产生海量原始遥测与衍生数据，其科学产出高度依赖科学地面段（Science Ground Segment，SGS）：SGS 将卫星下传数据转化为经过定标、验证并可科学利用的数据产品，涵盖观测计划、管道处理、元数据与数据溯源管理、跨数据中心计算调度、质量控制及数据发布等环节。Data Release（DR）是经过统一版本化、验证并面向社区发布的数据集合；DR1 作为 Euclid 的首个数据发布，其组织与运行体现了大规模天文数据处理和分布式科学运行的工程范式。
contribution: 本文系统介绍为 Euclid Data Release 1（DR1）实施的科学地面段（SGS）架构与运行模式。SGS 由 Euclid 科学运行中心、科学数据中心、仪器运行团队及支持组织单元组成，并在统一的架构与流程框架下协同工作。文章概述 SGS 公共基础设施，重点说明 Euclid 归档系统（EAS）：它是基于公共数据模型的中央元数据仓库，包含跨科学数据中心提供可扩展文件存储的分布式存储系统（DSS）、供处理管道登记和访问文件及其溯源关系的数据处理系统（DPS），以及向社区分发经验证数据产品的科学归档（SA）。处理任务由基于基础设施抽象层（IAL）的统一编排框架协调，实现工作流管理与分布式计算集群的资源抽象；软件开发、集成与部署则由公共开发环境（CDE）支持。文章还描述日常运行、定标与质量控制，以及 DR1 生产活动中的处理流程、验证策略和计算与数据规模。该基础设施支撑 Euclid DR1 **在九个科学数据中心完成 3500 万个作业、消耗 670 万核心小时（core-hours）**，**表明 SGS 具备鲁棒性与可扩展性**。
summary: The Euclid mission is designed to address fundamental questions on the nature of dark energy and dark matter by mapping the extragalactic sky with a wide-area survey complemented by targeted deep observations. The required scientific performance places stringent demands on the Euclid Science Ground Segment (SGS), which transforms raw telemetry into calibrated, validated, and scientifically exploitable products. The SGS is a distributed system comprising the Euclid Science Operations Centre, the Science Data Centres, Instrument Operation Teams, and supporting Organisation Units, within a common architectural and procedural framework. This paper presents the SGS as implemented for Data Release 1 (DR1), describing its organisation, architecture, processing functions, and operational model. We outline the main components of the SGS common infrastructure. A key element is the Euclid Archive System (EAS), the central metadata repository based on a common data model. It comprises a Distributed Storage System, providing scalable storage of data files across the Science Data Centres; a Data Processing System used by the pipelines to register and access files and their lineage; and a Science Archive, distributing validated data products. Processing is coordinated by a common orchestration framework based on the Infrastructure Abstraction Layer, providing workflow management and resource abstraction of distributed compute clusters. Software development, integration, and deployment are supported by the Common Development Environment. We describe daily operations, calibration, and quality control, followed by the DR1 production campaign, including processing flows, validation strategy, and computational and data volumes. This infrastructure enabled Euclid DR1, involving 35 million jobs across nine Science Data Centres and 6.7 million core-hours, demonstrating robustness and scalability of the SGS.

title: Euclid data release 1 (DR1) - SIR spectroscopic calibration
background_knowledge: Euclid 是欧洲空间局主导的暗能量与暗物质探测任务，其核心手段是通过大面积巡天测量宇宙大尺度结构，并结合弱引力透镜与星系成团等探针限制宇宙学模型。为此，任务需要获取大量星系的光度与光谱信息；其中近红外光谱由 NISP（Near-Infrared Spectrometer and Photometer）仪器以无缝光谱方式获得，即在红、蓝 grism 模式下直接对视场成像并色散天体光谱。无缝光谱的优点是巡天效率高，但不同天体的光谱会在探测器上重叠，且仪器响应、几何畸变、杂散光、焦平面位置依赖等效应十分复杂。因此，科学管线通常无法仅靠科学观测自身完成自校准，而必须依赖专门的定标观测、特定指向序列和独立定标管线，建立波长与流量标度，并将整个焦平面作为统一系统建模，以保证视场内天体测量与光谱性质的连续性。定标产品质量直接决定了最终光谱红移和谱线测量的可靠性，是 Euclid 大尺度结构宇宙学分析的基础环节。
contribution: 论文详细描述了为 Euclid 数据发布 1（DR1）科学管线生成定标产品的 SIR（Spectral near InfraRed）定标管线。由于无缝光谱数据本身复杂，科学观测无法由科学管线自行校准，因此需要利用专门的指向序列与观测天区构建独立定标产品，以确保约化光谱在波长和流量上满足任务要求。该工作的关键挑战在于将整个焦平面作为一个统一实体进行建模，从而维持全视场内的天体测量与光谱连续性。**DR1 在红、蓝 grism 模式下提供了超过 1.7 亿条经验证的光谱**；对定标产品及由此得到的科学光谱的综合分析表明，**当前定标结果成功满足任务要求**。论文同时指出了需要优化的具体环节，并说明相关工作正在持续开展，以进一步提升未来数据发布的质量。
summary: The Euclid space mission is dedicated to probing the nature of dark energy and dark matter, through a comprehensive mapping of the Universe's large-scale structure. Central to these cosmological goals are the spectra produced by the Near-Infrared Spectrometer and Photometer (NISP) and reduced by the scientific pipelines of the SIR (Spectral near InfraRed) processing function. Due to the intrinsic complexity of slitless spectroscopic data, scientific observations cannot be self-calibrated by the science pipelines. Consequently, the development of dedicated SIR calibration pipelines, utilising specific pointing sequences and observation fields, is essential. The resulting calibration products are fundamental to ensuring that reduced spectra are characterised within requirements in both wavelength and flux. This paper provides a detailed description of the SIR calibration pipelines responsible for generating the products utilised by the science pipelines for Data Release 1 (DR1). A significant challenge in these calibration tasks arises from the requirement to model the entire focal plane as a unified entity.
